arabic_text: المرأة في السودان [مقال] / خالة زاهرة في الكلية الطبية بالخرطوم
translation: "Women in Sudan" — feature on the changing role of women in Sudanese public life; photos of "Aunt Zahira," a Sudanese medical student, examining a hospitalized patient at Khartoum's medical college — she is one of the first Sudanese women to enter the medical profession; also a photo of an activist speaking at a women's federation microphone; text describes struggles for women's political and educational rights

arabic_text: المرأة في السودان (تتمة) / خلع بيري ونقاش أحد مراكز رعاية الطفولة والأمومة بمدينة المرغى
translation: "Women in Sudan" (continued) — more photos of Sudanese women's public activities: a fashionable woman photographed at home; a mother-and-child health clinic in the town of Al-Marghay showing a nurse weighing a Sudanese toddler on a balance; a group of professional women mingling at a reception; and a woman scientist working at a laboratory microscope

arabic_text: للنساء - الفتى الملون [مجموعة موديلات]
translation: "For Women" — fashion feature showcasing the season's youthful summer looks; main photo of a young model in a red-and-white gingham fit-and-flare dress and white flat shoes standing by a stone wall; two inset photos of a floral-print sleeveless dress and a copper-woven high-heel shoe; captions describe fabrics, cuts and price categories

arabic_text: للنساء - الجرزاية المفردة التخطيط [موضة كنزات مقلمة]
translation: "For Women" — knitwear fashion feature titled "The Single-Striped Sweater"; four photos of models in the season's striped-knit tops: brunette in a vertical black-and-white ringer top with headband, blonde in a boat-neck top with a scarf and pale trousers, and close-ups of a bangle and hooped-stripe sleeve details; text describes wool blends and how to wear the look

arabic_text: عن النجوم - زوجة تدفع الثمن / أكبر استديوهات العالم في أحضان الأرض / ممثلة الكليبرة تود اللهو في فلم عربي / الممرضة الجميلة
translation: "About the Stars" — celebrity news page: (1) "A wife pays the price" — Hollywood story of a starlet whose jealous rages cost her a role; three photos of the actress: at a hair salon, in a headshot, and in an ornate print blouse; (2) "The world's largest studios in the bosom of the earth" — feature on underground film sets; (3) "The Clay-berry actress wants to appear in an Arab film" — starlet who wants an Arabic-language role; (4) "The Beautiful Nurse" — glamour shot of a model in a bathing suit

arabic_text: حكايات - اختطفها لِيلقيها الغناء / جاء من الشعر المستعار / ترويض ممثلة شرسة
translation: "Tales" — celebrity gossip page: (1) "She was kidnapped so she'd sing!" — story about a starlet abducted to force her to perform (Italian actress); full-length photo of her seated on the floor in a slinky black cocktail dress; (2) "He came out of the wigs" — item about a Hollywood star who owes his career to elaborate hairpieces; (3) "Taming a fierce actress" — profile of a difficult star tamed by a strict director; small inset headshot of a smiling starlet

arabic_text: بينما كنت في طريقي إلى غرفة الملابس (تتمة قصة) / قصة كأنشتاين أعرب لنا رسبت / رسم ملاكمة
translation: Continuation of a short story ("While I was on my way to the dressing room…"): boxing-themed romance/drama; large full-color illustration of two boxers grappling in a boxing ring, painted in punchy red-and-white; text continues from an earlier page (referenced page 39)

arabic_text: قصة العدد: عمران - بقلم سمير عبد العزيز صنى / لجميع الأجهزة والأدوات الكهربائية G.E.C. [إعلان]
translation: "Story of the Issue: Omran" — a new short story by Samir Abd al-Aziz Sanad, opening on a scene at a lakeside near a village / [Bottom half-page ad] G.E.C. (General Electric Company Ltd. of England): "For all electrical equipment and appliances" — illustration of a G.E.C. power-plant facility with turbines and generators; list of G.E.C. agents across Iraq, Jordan, Egypt, Syria, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Sudan

arabic_text: الأرض كما يراها العلماء - إن في «الشرر» بياناً وسحراً! / ١) هل تدري أن البرق يقدح في الثانية الواحدة ١٠٠ قدحة؟ / ٢) الشرارة «كهرباء» تخترق الهواء / ٣) عداد «جايجر»
translation: "The Earth as Scientists See It" — installment: "There is Explanation and Enchantment in the 'Spark'!" — three sections: (1) "Did you know lightning strikes 100 times per second?" — atmospheric electricity and the physics of lightning, illustrated with a boy at a window watching a bolt strike over a city; (2) "The Spark ('Electricity') Pierces the Air" — dielectric breakdown of gases; (3) "The Geiger Counter" — how ionization detectors measure radiation, with a diagram of a Geiger tube

arabic_text: نصائح الطبيب - أمراض الطفل / حيث صعوبات الطريق شديدة هذا الإطار الأشد - دنلوب باور كريب ميجر [إعلان]
translation: "The Doctor's Advice" — pediatric health column: how to recognize and treat childhood diseases (measles, whooping cough, mumps, digestive complaints), when to seek professional help; small illustration of the medical-advice masthead / [Bottom ad] Dunlop "Powergrip Major" tire: "Where the road is toughest, this is the toughest tire" — designed to withstand the harshest conditions, for heavy trucks and off-road vehicles

arabic_text: حكام الإمارات المتصالحة في ساحل عمان [مقال]
translation: "The Rulers of the Trucial States on the Oman Coast" — feature on the Trucial sheikhs (the emirates that would become the UAE in 1971); grid of seven portraits of ruling sheikhs — Sheikh Shakhbut of Abu Dhabi, Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum of Dubai, the ruler of Sharjah, of Ajman, of Fujairah, of Umm Al Quwain, of Ras Al Khaimah — plus a photo of a modern white 3-storey Ottoman Bank building in one of the towns with 1950s American cars parked in front; small map of the Trucial Coast

arabic_text: العش... أكثر أعداء الإنسان ضرراً!
translation: "The Moth… Man's Most Damaging Enemy!" — pest-control feature on the clothes moth (illustrated with an enormous yellow-and-black photographic close-up of a moth on a black ground); explains the moth's life cycle, its enormous economic damage to wool, fur and stored fabrics; recommendations on prevention, mothballs, chemical treatments, and modern mothproofing

arabic_text: العش (تتمة) / تجارب العلماء / ٤ أجيال قادرة على تلف أكثر من ١٨ بدلة صوفية أو أكثر من ٤٦ فستاناً صوفياً
translation: "The Moth" (continued) — scientific research on moth breeding; photos of scientists holding specimen jars, a scientist examining insects under lab conditions, greenhouse experiments, and a fashion illustration of a couple in a chic red-and-black plaid dress with a matching man's suit; caption warns: "A single moth's four generations can ruin more than 18 wool suits or 46 wool dresses"

arabic_text: للنساء - موديلات فساتين وأزياء متنوعة [٦ صور]
translation: "For Women" — Paris/Milan fashion grid: six model photos numbered 3–8: (3) tan skirt-suit with a Cocker Spaniel on a leash; (4) full-skirt printed dress with white gloves; (5) sky-blue chiffon dress with pleated skirt; (6) chestnut-brown paisley knit dress; (7) white belted trench-jacket over a slim skirt; (8) leopard-print full-skirt dress with belted waist and matching hood

arabic_text: تعاون عالمي على محاربة السل / الفلبين / بقنوة
translation: "Global Cooperation to Fight Tuberculosis" — feature on WHO/UNICEF's global anti-TB program; large photo of two surgeons in an operating theater; text: "The Philippines received from Filipino compensation funds all the medical and hospital equipment necessary to protect the health of mothers and children in a large area of the Philippine Islands" — plus figures on TB deaths and BCG-vaccination goals

arabic_text: الجمهورية العربية المتحدة - دمشق / طلائع جديدة تقاوم بالغم / ليبيا
translation: "The United Arab Republic — Damascus" — TB campaign photo essay: a WHO mobile field clinic bus parked outside a Damascus school; women waiting in the clinic corridor; nurses testing children for TB with a skin test; text on how the campaign is deploying BCG vaccine in Syria and Egypt / Sidebar: "Libya — a follow-up class trained on the BCG vaccine in Tripoli, home of Libya's TB fighters"

arabic_text: فيتنام / هونغ كونغ / الأفغان / اكوادور [صور من الحملة العالمية لمحاربة السل]
translation: "Vietnam / Hong Kong / Afghanistan / Ecuador" — global TB campaign photo grid: (top) a Vietnamese doctor examines a child (fear-of-injections photo); nurse gives a Hong Kong child a BCG vaccination in a school clinic; (bottom) a doctor conducts a chest exam of a bare-chested elderly man in an Afghan clinic in Kabul; a lab worker prepares TB vaccines in a Latin American clinic

arabic_text: كهن يعد لنفسه مقبراً / عرس لا يعيب ضياع الوقت / إعلان أنبوب مام MUM الجديد [إعلان]
translation: "Strange but True" novelty column: photo of a fantastical pile of bulbous natural rock formations resembling a giant beehive — geological curiosity from Tayvan / "A priest who prepares his own grave" — brief; "A wedding that doesn't waste time" — human-interest story / [Bottom half-page ad] MUM anti-perspirant (Rollette and paste) from Bristol-Myers, London and New York: "The new MUM tube — reveals your natural charm" — with cartoon of a woman applying deodorant, and package shots of the MUM Rollette and MUM cream

arabic_text: المرأة العربية سلطانة بيتها
translation: "The Arab Woman — Queen of Her Home" — feature on the modern Arab housewife's role in running the household economy; two photos of a stylish modern living room with wood-lattice screens, area rug and low-slung sofa; and reception salon with a Louis-style side chair and vases; text argues that the housewife controls a significant share of family income and civic life

arabic_text: من منتخبات العالم [صورة كاملة الصفحة - فتاة إيطالية في مايو]
translation: "World Selections" full-page color portrait — young Italian starlet Colada (or similar) kneeling in the surf at the water's edge in a peach-colored one-piece swimsuit; short caption identifies her as an Italian actress recently discovered on the shores of Positano, chosen for a starring film role

arabic_text: الأرض كما يراها العلماء - النخل - سيدة الغلال (تتمة) / الفصيلة البلاذمية / أسبرو ASPRO [إعلان] / شامبو درين DRENE [إعلان]
translation: "The Earth as Scientists See It" — feature: "The Palm Tree — Queen of Crops" (continuation) with sections on Batatas (potatoes), root vegetables, wheat and rice cultivation, and various vegetable species; photos of potato crops in seed trays; text explains how a single seed potato can yield 90–120 kilograms per hectare / [Bottom-left ad] ASPRO tablets: "Aspro gives you the strength to overcome pain" / [Bottom-right ad] DRENE shampoo: "Nourishes hair and gives it luster"

arabic_text: للنساء - للأمهات [مجموعة أزياء وموضة سيدات]
translation: "For Women — For Mothers" — spring fashion feature; two model photos: a brunette in a boxy pale-blue skirt-suit and long white gloves, and a redhead in a golden-yellow bouclé skirt-suit with matching pillbox hat; the "For Mothers" sidebar discusses fabric choices, styling for the modern mom, and answers to readers' letters on children's health

arabic_text: روبرت أصغر الكابلة / الفلم الأميركي - هبت الريح مع الحب [شريط أفلام]
translation: "Bob Hope, the Youngest of the Kids" — celebrity/family feature: three film-still photos of an American drama: (top) actor arguing on a Victorian porch and a starlet in a rowboat; (middle) a couple in a bedroom scene with a redheaded woman screaming beside a Big Ben alarm clock; (bottom) a Cary Grant-like leading man in a family portrait with three children and his wife — a family drama film review

arabic_text: جين منسفيلد توقف مناورة عسكرية / أجرة تعرف التعليم البيتني / موقف سينمائي رائع / السعادة غير المال والشهرة والجمال / من عكسه غض الطرف عنها
translation: "About the Stars" gossip page: (1) "Jayne Mansfield halts a military maneuver" — brief on the actress causing an on-set disruption; blonde-hair Jayne photo top left; (2) "An actress who is a homemaker" — starlet perched on a wrought-iron chair with a pet dog; (3) "A wonderful cinema moment" — brief item on a memorable film scene; (4) "Happiness is not money, fame or beauty" — inset article; (5) portrait of a brunette starlet in a bath towel, "Whose beauty could no one look away from?"

arabic_text: قصة العدد: صديقة الأطفال - حيلة البغاء في إخفاء الجثة المسمومة أنقذت صاحبها من عذاب الضمير والنار وتركت القدر يصدر حكمه...
translation: "Story of the Issue: The Children's Friend" — a crime/psychological short story: "The parrot's trick in hiding the poisoned corpse saved its owner from the torment of conscience and hell, and left fate to render its verdict…"; large dramatic illustration of a startled parrot bursting into a room where a man reacts in horror as another man watches — the parrot appears to reveal a hidden crime

arabic_text: حكايات عن النجوم - أروع الراقصات ولدت كسيحة / زوجان يتفرقان على أنواع الغزل / حبا الممثل الكبير شعلا / عدة حقيقي عمل أدوار العمدة
translation: "Tales of the Stars" — celebrity news: (1) "The most amazing dancer was born crippled" — inspiring story of a paralyzed girl who became a professional dancer; large color photo of a redhead in a burgundy leotard-and-hose performing a raised-leg pose; (2) "A couple splits over threads of yarn" — celebrity divorce over knitting; small inset of a young couple with a puppy; (3) "Love kindled the great actor" — Frank Sinatra-like crooner headshot; (4) "A real feud plays the roles of the mayor" — brief on a stage actor

arabic_text: قصة العدد: عشقت ابنة سفاح... - كل واحد من سكان القرية كان يرجف رعباً من أبيها وأنا أعشقهم ولكن... لو كانت ابنة الشيطان لما ترددت في زواجها
translation: "Story of the Issue: I Loved a Murderer's Daughter…" — a romantic thriller short story: "Every villager trembled in fear of her father, yet I loved them. But even if she had been the devil's daughter, I would not have hesitated to marry her"; illustrated with a striking portrait of a wide-eyed brunette leaning on a mantelpiece, and a sepia-toned inset of two women in period dress in a doorway

arabic_text: أشكر كولجيت فهو سبب نجاحي - كولجيت COLGATE بمعجون أسنان GARDOL [إعلان]
translation: [Full-page ad] Colgate Dental Cream with Gardol: "I thank Colgate — it's the reason for my success" — testimonial-style advertisement showing an airline stewardess and cartoon scenes of her at work (welcoming passengers, checking in a business traveler, receiving a bouquet by the Leaning Tower of Pisa); slogan: "Colgate freshens the mouth, cleans and protects teeth" — pack shot of the classic red-and-white Colgate tube

arabic_text: هذه هي المساعدات القيمة... / تعليم الأمهات في الإقليم الجنوبي من الجمهورية العربية المتحدة طريقة إطعام أولادها الصغار حبوب الفيتامين المختلفة / جهود صندوق إغاثة الأطفال الدولي في البلاد العربية
translation: "These Are the Valuable Aid Contributions…" — feature title spread for a report on UNICEF's work in the Arab world; large color photo of a young Sudanese/Egyptian mother holding her infant while a health worker holds a UNICEF box of Vitamin A+D beads and demonstrates administering vitamin supplements to a baby; text on the U.N. children's fund's programs in Egypt, Sudan and other Arab countries

arabic_text: أنواع المساعدة للاجئين الفلسطيني / الجمهورية العربية المتحدة
translation: "Types of Aid to Palestinian Refugees" — sidebar on UNICEF/UNRWA emergency assistance to Palestinian refugee camps in Jordan and Syria, with photo of a physician in dark goggles (X-ray goggles) examining a baby for skin/eye disease at a Cairo mobile clinic; "The United Arab Republic" — a UNICEF mobile clinic in an Egyptian village, with health workers vaccinating villagers and distributing food supplements

arabic_text: مكافحة الملاريا وغيرها في العراق / في السودان وعدن والصومال ولبنان / مساعدات لبلاد الشرق الأدنى
translation: "Fighting Malaria and Other Diseases in Iraq" — photos of a Bristol-Myers vitamin-drink pharmacy dispensing bottles to a mother, and a doctor with a WHO campaign banner examining a child in Beirut; text describes UNICEF aid to Iraq, Sudan, Aden, Somalia and Lebanon for anti-malaria, TB, and eye-disease campaigns

arabic_text: أحدث دور السينما المفتوحة في بومباي / لجميع الأجهزة والأدوات الكهربائية G.E.C. [إعلان] / مشاهد من فيلم روبن هود
translation: "The Newest Cinema Complex Open in Bombay" — photo feature on the Maratha Mandir cinema in Bombay with poster for a Hindi film; film-review stills from a Hollywood family drama — a housewife in a domestic scene, a leading man on a bed with a wounded soldier, and a couple in a rock grotto with candles / [Left half-page ad] G.E.C. English electrical equipment for all industrial and commercial applications

arabic_text: الاكتشاف صنع المرضى - السرطان أسبابه وأعراضه
translation: "The Diseases That Discovery Creates — Cancer: Its Causes and Symptoms" — long health feature: photo of a scientist operating a centrifuge/cyclotron in a research lab; photo of a heavy traffic jam representing urban pollution; extreme close-up photo of an ashtray with a lit cigarette next to reading glasses (symbolizing tobacco's role in cancer); sections on cancers of the mouth, lung, skin, blood, breast; explains carcinogens and early-warning signs

arabic_text: حكايات عن النجوم - نجمة تؤمن بالتنجيم / سعادة في الحب على الشاشة / باتريشيا أوين
translation: "Tales of the Stars": (1) "A star who believes in astrology" — feature; large color photo of a giggling blonde starlet in denim shorts holding a long fishing rod, standing barefoot; (2) "Happiness in love on the screen" — profile of actress Patricia Owens; portrait of Patricia Owens in a headscarf; (3) "How to sweeten the flavor of a marriage" — brief item

arabic_text: نجمة تستمع إلى إرشادات زوجها / أودري هيبورن وزوجها ميل فرير / مهدها كان صندوق خشب / المال غير مهم في نظره
translation: "Tales of the Stars" (continued): (1) "A star who listens to her husband's guidance" — Audrey Hepburn feature; photo of Audrey Hepburn and husband Mel Ferrer; (2) "Her cradle was a wooden crate" — rags-to-riches profile of an Italian starlet (probably Gina Lollobrigida), shown seated barefoot on a haystack in an off-shoulder peasant blouse and orange skirt; (3) "Money is unimportant to him" — Anthony Quinn-like portrait

arabic_text: أحب الزواج وأكره الطلاق - جينجر روجرز / المنجمة قالت لها ستتزوجين قريباً - لورين باكال / عشرون عاماً في عيد متواصل - روبرت تايلور
translation: "Tales of the Stars" continued: (1) "I love marriage and hate divorce" — Ginger Rogers profile; photo of Ginger Rogers dancing in a white gown with two partners; (2) "The astrologer told her: you will marry soon" — Lauren Bacall profile; portrait photo; (3) "Twenty years in a continuous celebration" — Robert Taylor feature; portrait of the actor

arabic_text: قصة العدد: الرجل الهائل - أقرب الرحلات في الشاطئ... وسط الظلمات الرقصة عرف عندي كوري نار الحب / كرافن أ CRAVEN A [إعلان]
translation: "Story of the Issue: The Wandering Man" — a romantic short story; dramatic sailor-hat portrait illustration of a young Navy officer with a small woman's face over his shoulder; teaser: "On the closest shore trips, amid the darkness and dance-fires, I recognized my Korean girl by the fire of love" / [Bottom-left ad] Craven A virgin cigarettes: portrait of an elegant woman with a red-white Craven A cigarette pack

arabic_text: لكل ساقطة لاقطة يستطيع الفأر الاختباء من الفخ [صور متحركة لفأر يهرب من مصيدة]
translation: "For Every Trap There's an Escape — the Mouse Can Hide from the Snare" — humor/photo-essay: sequence of black-background photographs of a white lab-mouse cleverly maneuvering around a snap trap, stealing the cheese bait, and escaping; captions in cartoon-strip style; below, a data table comparing populations, mice caught and mouse deaths in Britain, USA, France, USSR and Sweden

arabic_text: الأرض كما يراها العلماء - الإنسان مجبول من ذرات! / ١) أنت ذرى! / ٢) الذرات صغيرة الحجم جداً / ٣) الذرات قاسية صلبة / ٤) الذرات يمكن تصويرها فوتوغرافياً
translation: "The Earth as Scientists See It" — new installment: "Man is Made of Atoms!" — four sections: (1) "You Are Atoms!" — atomic-scale intro; (2) "Atoms Are Extremely Small" — with a magnifying-glass illustration; (3) "Atoms Are Hard and Solid" — with ricochet diagram; (4) "Atoms Can Be Photographed" — with electron-microscope image of a crystal lattice caption "A city at night? No — it's the first photograph of the atomic structure!"

arabic_text: ٥) حقيقة الذرات لم تكن مجرد مباغتة / ٦) أول من اكتشف الذرة / ٧) فصائل الذرة وأشكالها / ٨) طريقة وزن الذرة / ٩) بعض الذرات قابل للتغير... وبعضها خطر! / ١٠) ما هو جوهر الذرة
translation: "The Earth as Scientists See It" (continued): (5) "The reality of atoms is no coincidence" — with cameo portraits of John Dalton and Antoine Lavoisier; (6) "Who first discovered the atom?" — Democritus (Ancient Greece) and modern chemists; (7) "Species and shapes of atoms" — diagrams: sodium + chlorine = salt (NaCl); (8) "How atoms are weighed" — mass spectrometry; (9) "Some atoms can change, and some are dangerous!" — isotopes and radioactivity; (10) "What is the essence of the atom?" — teaser for next issue

arabic_text: أصحاب الأجسام الكاملة [صور قراء - أبطال كمال أجسام]
translation: "Bodybuilders" — reader-submitted bodybuilding photo grid: seven black-and-white portraits of young men flexing in the classic bodybuilding stances, including a photo of the winner of the Egyptian/UAR bodybuilding championship at the Armed Forces Cup competition; captions identify each with name, city and country (Egypt, Sudan, Morocco); at bottom a group photo of an entire bodybuilding-club team lined up

arabic_text: العدد السادس - السنة الثانية / نوفمبر ١٩٥٨ - ربيع الثاني ١٣٧٨ / جامعة القاهرة / مواطنة ومستشرقوها / بلاد جنوب الجزيرة / صورة بالألوان الطبيعية للنجمة السينمائية باتي رود
translation: Cover/masthead of Al-Alam magazine — Issue No. 6, Year 2 — November 1958 / Rabi' al-Thani 1378; large color cover photo of a smiling blonde actress in a floral blue dress in front of an aquarelle vignette of Cairo University's clock tower and dome; issue highlights listed on the yellow banner: "Cairo University," "Yugoslavia and its Orientalists," "South-Arabian Countries"; bottom banner: "Free full-color pin-up of cinema star Patti Rowe inside" and issue prices by country (Egypt 20m, Sudan 20 pt, Iraq 20 fils, Jordan 20 fils, Libya 20m, Syria 25 pt, Lebanon 25 pt, Morocco 50 francs, Tunisia 50m)

arabic_text: إن سطح المائدة هو الأهم! - فورمايكا FORMICA على جميع الأثاثات [إعلان] / أسبرو ASPRO للتغلب على الألم [إعلان]
translation: [Top ad] Formica laminates: "The table surface is what matters most!" — for furniture across Syria, Lebanon, Iraq, Jordan, Sudan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia — cartoon of a happy couple sharing coffee at a Formica-topped table with waiter / [Bottom ad] ASPRO tablets to overcome pain — cartoon of a strong man breaking through pain with pills packet; distributor addresses in Iraq, Lebanon, Jordan, Bahrain, Kuwait, Iran, Syria, Egypt, Sudan

arabic_text: جامعة القاهرة في خدمة العلم خمسين سنة - بقلم الدكتور جمال الدين الرمادي
translation: "Cairo University: Fifty Years in the Service of Knowledge" — feature by Dr. Jamal Al-Din Al-Ramadi, marking the university's 50th anniversary; full-page hand-painted illustration of the Cairo University main campus — the iconic Great Dome and clock tower framed by palm-lined gardens, ornamental fountains and a period sedan approaching the gates; text on the university's founding in 1908, its role in modernizing Egyptian higher education, its faculties, and its regional influence

arabic_text: جامعة القاهرة (تتمة) - سفر الجامعة القاهرة ومكسبها بالنكات والمكتبة العامة والعلوم / الطبقات الشرقية في الجامعة / كلية دار العلوم
translation: "Cairo University" (continued) — architectural sketch pages: an illustration of the university's clock-tower plaza and administrative buildings with a period car and pedestrians; illustration of the classical-Islamic Dar Al-Ulum college building (founded 1872) with its wooden mashrabiyya balconies; sections on the university's science and humanities faculties, its general library, the Sharif-endowed Eastern classes, and its role as a magnet for students from across the Arab world

arabic_text: حكايات عن النجوم - مارلين مونرو تؤمر بإنقاص وزنها / وصايا نفيسة للشباب اليافع / شقيقة بريجيت باردو تخدع هوليود

translation: "The Mysterious Crime" — serialized crime story, continuation on p.31 / [Right-top ad] CLERSANGES PARIS eau-de-toilette and hair-refresher — with lady in evening gown; sole agents Shita & Co. / [Right-bottom ad] Hollywood Egypt Films presents "Maktab Al-Gharam" (The Love Bureau) — Egyptian musical film starring Hoda Shams al-Din, directed by Shams al-Din — currently in Cairo cinemas

translation: "Next Issue Preview: The Summer Issue" — teaser page for the magazine's forthcoming summer number, 96 pages for 6 piasters: cover-mockup of a smiling brunette in a blue-and-white sailor blouse behind a car steering wheel; charming photo feature on Egyptian children dressed as "Bedouin family" for a play (small girl as bride, boys as bearded groom and umda/mayor); text lists 60 pages of summer content, humor pieces, and cinema/travel articles from Cairo, Alexandria, Beirut and Damascus

arabic_text: حريتي.. يظهر السارق! [قصة قصيرة]
translation: "My Freedom… the Thief Appears!" — a short story with a cartoon illustration of a cinema studio scene: a woman in checked cowgirl outfit and pigtails with a masked female bandit at gunpoint, both surrounded by film-set spotlights and a spinning reel; caption: "The actress: 'I'm going to make you into a bunch of dust!' — The colleague: 'The director told her to act with realism to make it look natural!'"

arabic_text: الحاس (لبنان) - عش السالمة كذا / جائزتي.. / وتبتسم اللعبة الجدية!
translation: "Al-Nahhas (Lebanon) — 'Life is Safe So-and-So'" — political-humor commentary on Prime Minister Al-Nahhas's diplomacy; large photo of an outdoor tennis match between two players with a Union-Jack-emblazoned Egyptian player at net; below, reader-response column "My Prize…" and "The Serious Game Smiles!" — mixing sports, politics and readers' letters critiquing government policy

arabic_text: دورة الجامعة.. كما يرويها على عمو الدين / مصطفى النحاس باشا / رياض الصلح بك / توفيق السويدى بك / الشيخ يوسف ياسين / محمد صلاح الدين بك / الأستاذ حبيب أبو شهلا / أحمد على باشا
translation: "The Arab League Summit Meeting — as told by Ali Amuddin" — political reportage on the founding Arab League summit; four black-and-white photos of the Arab leaders in session — heads of state in traditional dress and Western suits sitting around the conference table; portraits and quotes from Egyptian PM Mustafa Al-Nahhas, Lebanese PM Riad Al-Solh, Iraqi statesman Tawfiq Al-Suwaidi, Saudi Sheikh Yusuf Yasin, Egyptian FM Muhammad Salah Al-Din, Lebanese diplomat Habib Abu Chahla, and Yemeni delegate Ahmad Ali Pasha

arabic_text: أتكنسون ATKINSONS - ماء كولون [إعلان] / تمنيات لتكسنت لسنة ١٩٤٦ من العددالراسل القاهرة [إعلان مهني] / زواج تحية [قصة]
translation: [Top-right ad] ATKINSONS Eau de Cologne (British Empire) — full drawing of a chic 1940s couple, the woman in fur cape and the man in a suit, plus product illustration of the bottle; "For every place and every time — a refreshing bottle of Atkinsons cologne with the finest floral fragrance" / "Congratulations for 1946" — official greetings from a Cairo publisher / "Tahia's Marriage" — a serialized romance-story installment

arabic_text: قريباً - سميرة موسى في خفايا الدنيا - سيناريو الأستاذ بديع دومى / بيتها الكرسال بالقاهرة [إعلان فيلم] / آخر مبتكرات الشبراويشى - بون سوار Bon Soir [إعلان عطر] / صابون لوريول LORIOL للشباب [إعلان] / كوين اليزابث [إعلان بودرة تجميل]
translation: [Left-column ad] Coming Soon: Samira Moussa in "Khafaya Al-Donia" (Secrets of the World) — Egyptian film; scenario by Prof. Badie Doumi; large drawing of a groom in tuxedo lighting a cigarette with an inset photo of the bride Samira Moussa in wedding dress / [Right-column ads] Bon Soir eau-de-toilette from Al-Shobrawichi; Loriol shaving soap; Queen Elizabeth complexion powder for a smooth, silky skin

arabic_text: هذه السيارة لك من «الاثنين والمصور» - سيارة كرايزلر Chrysler [إعلان جائزة] / الأستاذ زهير مصرى المالك القدير للمطبعة
translation: "This Car Is Yours from Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Musawwar!" — competition-prize ad featuring a brand-new 1946 Chrysler Windsor sedan being offered as first prize in the joint magazine drawing; entry rules and total prize value L.E. 1,200 / Feature: "Professor Zoheir Masri, the Master of the Standard Press" — two documentary photos of the printing-press owner working at his typesetting machine and adjusting a large printing-press cylinder

arabic_text: قهر ١٤ من الاثنين ٣ من إبريل - بيينا ستوديو مصر - فيلم فاسدة - محمود ذو الفقار، سامية جمال، حسين فايز، فردوس محمد، عبد الفتاح القصري، ولاد عبد الحميد / إعلان الهلال
translation: "Egyptian Cinema News — Studio Misr Presents 'Fasedah' (The Corrupt Woman)" — poster/still ad for a new Egyptian film starring Mahmoud Zulfikar, Samia Gamal, Hussein Fayez, Ferdous Mohammed, Abdel Fattah Al-Qasari, and Awlad Abd al-Hamid — premiering 3 April at the National Studio Misr theatres; full-column dramatic ad with the film cast in still-photograph / [Right side] The Al-Hilal magazine special "summer/spring issue" ad, 200 pages, 6 piasters

arabic_text: الاثنين والدنيا العدد ٨٤٧ - ٤ سبتمبر ١٩٥٠ - ميزان الحب - في مفترق الطريق [غلاف عدد]
translation: Full-color magazine cover — Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Donia (Monday & The World) magazine, Issue No. 847, 4 September 1950; theme "The Balance of Love — At a Crossroads": full-page photograph of a smiling brunette in a pink raincoat holding a large tartan-plaid open umbrella overhead against a blue sky; cover price 20m; header masthead in the classic red-and-white magazine logo

arabic_text: كوبيد في دنيا الطيور - كيف يزاول كوبيد الخوارف والفشرة والفلور الأنيق في دنيا الطيور والحيوانات! / خطبة زفاف طائرة
translation: "Cupid in the Bird World — How Cupid arranges betrothals, engagements, and elegant flirtations in the animal kingdom!" — humorous natural-history illustrated article: six comic vignettes with drawings of courting birds (peacocks displaying feathers, spider-web-weaving spiders, love-doves, penguins in tuxedos, colorful fish, crab-and-lobster couples); each vignette a witty tale of animal mating rituals

arabic_text: نصاب أضحك الأباظة - كاترجيها هؤلاء من قبل! / السيد المجهول [إعلان تنجيمي] / بلسامول [إعلان دواء يوقف الكحة] / السيدة على الكبير جمعية المرأة المدنية ويوم المستشفيات - إعلان
translation: "A Swindler Who Made the Pashas Laugh" — feature on a legendary Egyptian con-artist who fooled cabinet ministers and pashas with clever schemes; illustrated with cartoon of a Nassab (swindler) getting away with the goods / [Ads] "The Unknown Gentleman" — L.E. 5000 fortune-teller/matchmaking service; BALSAMOL cough syrup — treats influenza, calms coughs; charity notice for Mrs. Ali Al-Kabir's civic women's association and hospitals day

arabic_text: لا يعجبني في أبي.. - للآنسة لبلى كريمة فريد أبو شادى بك / صورة كاملة الصفحة - الآنسة لبلى فريد أبو شادى
translation: "What I Don't Like About My Father…" — personal essay by Miss Laila (daughter of Farid Abu Shady Bey); large color portrait of Miss Laila Farid Abu Shady, in a red velvet jacket with pearl necklace; the article playfully catalogues her father's quirks: his devotion to poetry evenings while she wants outdoor fun, his old-fashioned views on radio programs, his habit of expecting family to attend Qur'an recitations, etc. — a humorous personal essay from a modern young woman

arabic_text: لأول مرة في الإسكندرية - أحمد سالم - دموع الفرح / مديحة يسرى، حسن فايق، إسماعيل ياسين، عادل ناصر، ثريا فخري، فؤاد شقيق / أفلام فرانتيا Ferrania [إعلان] / امتحان في قصة! / إعلان WORLD SHOE POLISH وورنيش الكرة
translation: "For the First Time in Alexandria — Ahmad Salem's 'Dumu' al-Farah' (Tears of Joy)" — film-release announcement for an Egyptian melodrama; three inset headshots of the stars: Madiha Yousry, Hassan Fayek, Ismail Yassin, Adel Nasser, Thoraya Fakhri, Fouad Shafik / [Ads] Ferrania Italian film stock; "World Shoe Polish" — with cartoon of a shining shoe / Front page teaser: "A Story Quiz" contest

arabic_text: البنيه.. محصل العوائد / حكمة سليمان في نصائح الأزواج - بقلم السيد الحديدي
translation: "The Little Girl… Tax Collector" — humorous domestic story by Ahmad Ubaid: a father recounts the shrewd financial reasoning of his young daughter, who insists on being paid pocket-money for household chores; illustrated with cartoon of a chubby matron scolding a smaller pouting girl / "Solomon's Wisdom in Marital Advice" — sidebar of pithy sayings on husband-wife relationships

arabic_text: قصة مصورة: العجلة من الشيطان! / مازدا MAZDA - العلامة المشهورة في عالم الإضاءة [إعلان مصابيح] / واردات حديثاً - المخاديد، الأصواف الفاخرة، مغفرات المائدة، الملابس الجاهزة للأولاد - عبد الحميد مصطفى [إعلان]
translation: "Photo Story: Haste Is From the Devil!" — 6-panel photo-narrative of a young rich man who rushes his marriage and lives to regret it; photos of a bride at the tram stop, at a jewelry shop, at the wedding, and back at home / [Left-top ad] MAZDA light-bulbs — "The famous brand in the world of illumination" — Thomson-Houston British / [Left-bottom ad] Abdul Hamid Mustafa store — new imports: silk, luxury wools, table linens, ready-to-wear children's clothes

arabic_text: عندنا جيش من النساء..! / المصانع الحربية / الفرقة الميكانيكية / أعمال المخابرات
translation: "We Have an Army of Women!" — feature on Egyptian women in wartime military auxiliary services during WWII; large overhead photo of hundreds of women in uniform standing at attention in ranks on a parade ground; sections on the women's military factories, the mechanized transport corps, and the intelligence/messenger services; smaller photos of a woman firing a cannon and of women medics performing first-aid on a stretcher

arabic_text: يانصيب الاثنين والمصور - سحب في ١٧ يوليو ١٩٥٠ [إعلان جوائز] / أتكنسون ATKINSONS [إعلان عطر] / ليس بالمستحيل - كرسى بعثى / (البقية على صفحة ٤٩)
translation: "Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Musawwar Lottery — Drawing on 17 July 1950" — competition-prize ad: top prize a Chrysler Windsor car worth L.E. 1,200, plus cash prizes of L.E. 60, L.E. 50, L.E. 50, and L.E. 50; "Keep three coupons complete — you could be the lucky winner!" / [Middle-left ad] ATKINSONS eau-de-cologne / [Bottom ad] "Ba'thi" (Mission) chair — supporting government's mission chair budget line for public education

translation: [Right-top ad] MILLAMALT malt-extract for children — "Children love this strengthening drink!" — with cartoon of a strong smiling boy / [Right-bottom ad] Al-Kawakib magazine — 25 March 1950 issue includes a free "New Song" booklet, 5 piasters / [Left ads] Vicks VapoRub; "Vitabs" vitamins; a body-conditioning tonic / "A Story Quiz" contest answers page from an earlier issue

Start training for it NOW!" — correspondence-course careers list (dozens of professions listed for postal training)

translation: "Your Holiday… From a Matchbox!" — humorous DIY column: how to make simple children's toys and party favors from empty matchboxes and matchsticks — origami-style creatures and figurines / Cartoon at top: husband (in tarboosh reading almanac) tells wife (in red dress) "The calendar didn't include a note about our marriage anniversary even though it lists every misfortune of the year!" — wife retorts "They must be saving room for the bigger misfortunes!"

translation: "The Road to Perfection!" — bodybuilding column featuring reader-champion photos: a young man doing a heavy squat with barbell, and four flexing bodybuilder poses of Egyptian readers; each captioned with name, address and physique measurements / "The Story of Solomon Nadeek" — humorous short story by Anwar Al-Masry, with a comic anecdote from a Cairo café

translation: "A True-Life Story: Bakri… and Shukran" — nostalgic short story by Prof. Ismail Al-Gouk / "Released: The first Egyptian film entirely in natural color!" — feature on "Baba Aris" (Papa the Groom), starring Naima Akef, Abdel Salam Al-Nabulsy, Camelia and Fouad Shafik — the historic first Egyptian color feature film; two photos: (top) Naima Akef in a costume drama scene, and (bottom) a wedding-party scene with Naima, Abdel Salam Al-Nabulsy, Camelia and Fouad Shafik

arabic_text: نصائح ونقود قراء العدد [صفحة عربية] / ILFORD [إعلان أفلام تصوير]
translation: "Advice and Money to Issue Readers" — full spread of reader letters printed as small columns of tight Arabic text (a page for correspondents); topped by small photos of previous prize-winners; illustration of a family (father, teenage daughter, mother) reading the magazine together / [Bottom ad] ILFORD photographic film (British) — cartoon dog with camera / [Right] shoe-polish and beauty-product ads Cherry Blossom Boot Polish

translation: "Brothers of Purity… The Ancient Prose" — literary essay column / "Wisdom of the Week" and "Man of the Week" — brief editorial sidebars — cartoon shows an outraged fez-wearing gentleman kicking two smaller men through prison bars / "Marriage Solutions" — advice column with reader letters and short cartoon of a woman / "The Newborn Announces" — birth-announcement mini-column with cartoon

translation: "Do You Know?" — political-humor cartoon column: photo of three officials of the Prime Minister's cabinet exhausted from processing budget paperwork; below, a photo of another exhausted minister at his desk; commentary on cabinet drama and government financial disputes / [Left column] Cover-shot inset of actress Nour al-Huda / [Bottom-right ads] Sheikh Al-Shirbi tea; Qewaidar wa Toteeb — Cairo confectionery for the holidays

arabic_text: الاثنين والدنيا - العدد ٨٣٢ - ٢٠ مليماً - ٢٢ مايو ١٩٥٠ - في ربيع مايو [غلاف]
translation: Full-color magazine cover — Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Donia, Issue No. 832, 20 mm, 22 May 1950; theme "In the Springtime of May": studio portrait photo of a redheaded woman in an ochre yellow long-sleeve dress and gloves, wearing a fabulous wide-brimmed hat decorated with pink roses and cream flowers, red lipstick, against a coral-red backdrop; magazine masthead top right

translation: "Young Toughs (Fitiwwa) with a 'Former Tough'!" — feature on the disappearing folkloric character of the Egyptian street-tough (fitiwwa); large portrait photo of "Al-Haj Ibrahim in his fitiwwa days" — an old man reminiscing about his brawler youth in Cairo's Bulaq district in the 1920s-30s; smaller full-body photo of a young man in period fitiwwa costume with cane / [Right column ads] Regensy watches; the Egyptian film "Sameeh, Wanessa, and the Cairo Bills"; World Shoe Polish black shoe wax

arabic_text: على الرغم من ارتفاع سعر الزيتون في الخارج - لا يزال باعة صابون نابلسي روضة يبيعون بسعر القطعة ٥ملم - المصنوع من زيت الزيتون الخالص - مصانع صابون نقولا كحلا بك المصرية عمرة / سيقولون ما اروع جمالها عندما تستعملين ماكياج فيرى [إعلان]
translation: [Full-page ad] Nabulsi Rawda soap: "Despite the sharp rise in the international price of olive oil, Nabulsi Rawda Soap is still sold at 5 mils per bar" — made from pure olive oil — Nicola Kahla Bey Egyptian Soap Factories, Cairo; drawing of the traditional square soap bar with stamped seal / [Bottom-left ad] Fire cosmetics: "They will say — how amazing her beauty is! — when you use Fire Makeup"

arabic_text: بشاهرون العاب الفروسية - الأميرة فوزية شقيقة صاحب السمو الإمبراطوري رياض ولي عهد إيران / تحية السلام الإمبراطوري / في حديقة المنظرة بحرت الحفلة السنوية لألعاب الفروسية بطهران
translation: "Watching the Equestrian Games" — royal social feature: two photos of a state visit to Iran and the equestrian games held in the palace gardens at Tehran; Princess Fawzia (sister of the King of Egypt and Empress of Iran, wife of Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi) at the annual royal equestrian games with her sister-in-law Princess Shams; portraits of officers of the Persian Imperial Guard offering the imperial salute to the royals seated in the reviewing box

arabic_text: ما أحلاك يا ريد! - باقة من الزهر يقدمها طائفة الأزجالين بمناسبة حلول الربيع - قصيدة زجلية / أغلى من الدم / ما في في ضميرك؟! / صلاة الزين

arabic_text: تعلمت من الانتخابات - للأستاذ على أيوب بك / شاطئ الغرام - بيينا ستوديو مصر - وفريال بالإسكندرية - رخيتاء والبانك ببومباى [إعلان فيلم]
translation: "What I Learned From the Elections" — political satire essay by Prof. Ali Ayoub Bey on the recent parliamentary election campaign; illustrated with an amusing cartoon of a candidate in polka-dot suit and red frock-coat helping a chubby fez-wearing voter navigate the ballot / [Right side] Full-column film ad: "Shore of Love" — Studio Misr new Egyptian film; showing at Ferial cinema (Alexandria) and Reshita and Paramount cinemas (Bombay); inset photos of the three lead actresses

arabic_text: خاطف الأطفال - غز مستفار سابق [قصة مصورة]

arabic_text: سكك حديد الحكومة المصرية - صرف تذاكر مشتركة للسفر بين مصر والسودان [إعلان رسمي]

translation: "Everything" — news/reviews digest column: news items on the Wafd party, the Palestine question, Anglo-Egyptian treaty negotiations, and the Arab League session; small cartoon of a fez-wearing man with speech bubble; "Al-Ithnayn Archive" — feature honoring two departed editors of the magazine, Mazham Al-Balqemy and Elias Al-Qoromani, with portraits and brief biographies of their contributions to Egyptian journalism

arabic_text: الاثنين والدنيا - العدد ٣٢٩ - القاهرة ٣٠ سبتمبر ١٩٤٠ - ٢٧ شعبان ١٣٥٩ - المطربة أسعان [صورة كاملة الصفحة كغلاف]
translation: Full-page black-and-white portrait — Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Donia magazine, Issue No. 329, Cairo 30 September 1940 / 27 Sha'ban 1359 — cover portrait of Egyptian singer/actress Asaan (or similar); studio close-up in high-key lighting: dark-haired singer looking up in profile, wearing pearl earrings and a light blue silk gown, with a slight smile; caption at bottom: "The talented singer Asaan portrays the role of Belula in front of her fiancé, singer Farid Al-Atrash, in the film 'Intisar Al-Shabab' (Victory of Youth)"

arabic_text: وحشتنى دى؟! [قصة]

translation: "The Great Ministers — Biography of Rushdi and Adly" — political history feature on Egyptian prime ministers Rushdi Pasha and Adly Yakan; illustrated with portrait photographs of Mohamed Kamel, Mustafa Kamel, Saad Zaghloul, and Mostafa Fahmy Pasha — the pantheon of early-20th-century Egyptian nationalist statesmen

translation: "Our Photographer at Cinema El-Nasr in Alexandria" — photo essay: children of Alexandria attending a special screening at El-Nasr cinema, with photos of the children lining up outside and inside the theater; also a photo report on the anniversary celebration of the Sekker family/company
