arabic_text: خطاب.. بصمة! [مقال] / إلى الأمهات - صحة طفلك في فصل الصيف - نسلة Nestle نستوجين، لاكتوجين، لبن نستله [إعلان حليب أطفال]
translation: "Khitab… Wa Basma!" (A Letter… and a Fingerprint!) — column on illiteracy in rural Egypt: charming anecdotal essay about a peasant woman who cannot read her son's letter and takes it to the village chief / [Right-column ad] Nestle infant formulas: NESTOGEN (Milk Powder, Half Sweet), LACTOGEN (Milk Powder Fortified), Nestle Milk Concentrate — with baby-in-oversized-hat illustration and 3 stacked can drawings

arabic_text: غلاف العدد ٨٤٧ - مورين أوهارا Maureen O'Hara [صورة غلاف ملون]
translation: Front cover full-color portrait of Hollywood actress Maureen O'Hara (Universal star), red-haired with an elaborate braided updo and white gardenia hair-flowers; magazine issue no. 847, Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Dunya, dated 4 September 1950, Cairo/Egypt/Sudan; price 20 milliemes; yellow crescent-moon Al-Ithnayn logo top-left

arabic_text: يوميات - أفلام الأسبوع - سينما الكورسال [إعلان فيلم] / بون سوار Bon Soir [إعلان كولونيا] / حفة زوجك [عمود نصائح]
translation: "Yawmiyaat" (Diary) column — feature/reviews of the week's films at Cairo cinemas / [Right column film ad] "Min Faat Qadeemah!" (From the Old Days!) at Sinama Al-Corsal — starring Mimi Shakib, Fouad Zaher; directed by Furid Le Nabi; with cast headshots / [Left column ad] Charrach Bon Soir cologne — with slim seated-lady illustration / "Guard Your Husband" advice column at right

arabic_text: أبريل في هوليوود - ديانا لين، آل جولسون، تايرون بور [صور نجوم]
translation: "April in Hollywood" — full-page Hollywood-gossip feature with three star portraits: Diana Lynn (large color close-up right, laughing red-lipsticked); Ella Raines top-left in polka-dot blouse; Tyrone Power bottom-left in dark portrait; text is a monthly round-up of April news from Hollywood — new marriages, contracts, and films

arabic_text: ٣٩ عاماً على باب كلية الحقوق! - أم فرحاي، أقدم فراش في جامعة فؤاد [مقال] / مصوغات جميل [إعلان]
translation: "39 Years at the Door of the Law College!" — human-interest feature/portrait on Um Farhy (the oldest servant/doorkeeper at the Fouad I University Faculty of Law), photographed in a suit with a distinctive tarbouche gesturing with his hand; text traces his years serving generations of law students and his memories of the students who became famous / [Right ads] Jameel gilded jewelry shop; "Have You Asthma? Faramen Zeuter" ointment ad

arabic_text: المعلم تربية والسيدة فتحية.. في المهرجان الصحي [صور مسرحية] - المدارس تحيي أسبوع الأمومة والطفولة
translation: "Master Tarbia and Mrs. Fatehia… at the Health Festival" — feature/photo essay on Egyptian schools' celebration of Mother-and-Child Health Week: three photos from a school theatrical production dramatizing hygiene lessons and family drama for the students; students in makeshift adult-role costumes on stage with parent-audience visible

arabic_text: قلب الأم - قصة مصرية
translation: "Qalb Al-Umm" (A Mother's Heart) — Egyptian short story on a full page with a decorative pink-hearts border across the top; a sentimental tale of a mother's sacrifice for her son during the current cost-of-living crisis; final scene involves a robber approaching the mother's house at night — heartwarming melodrama

arabic_text: ضحكات المدينة [قصة مصورة]
translation: "Dahakat Al-Madina" (Laughs of the City) — humor column/story with photo of a bearded Egyptian judge in court robes speaking with a schoolgirl; two elderly turbaned men (traditional sheikhs) sit to the side observing; comic legal-tale of a bilingual little girl outsmarting her rural elders in court; caption "His Excellency listens to the child's testimony"

arabic_text: نتيجة استفتاء - مسامحة! / بقية القصة.. / ردود القراء
translation: "Referendum Result — Mercy!" (Msamiha) — reader-poll results: readers voted on whether the wife-character in last week's story should have forgiven her husband; box with tally results / "Bakiyat Al-Qissa" (Rest of the Story) — final chapter of the two-part story / "Rudood Al-Qurra" (Reader Replies) column at the bottom

arabic_text: صور الأقطاب التي جمعتها.. الأستاذ كريم ثابت / الملك فيصل / جلالة رضا بهلوي / السيد رشدي / الدكتور بنيش [صور]
translation: "The Portraits I Collected of the Great Ones" — memoir feature by Prof. Kareem Thabet (private secretary and press adviser to King Farouk); four photographic portraits: (top) King Faisal II; (middle-large) Shah Reza Pahlavi of Iran with a general in full ceremonial dress; (bottom) Rushdi Bey and Dr. Bnaish (Beneš); text recounts his diplomatic-photograph collecting career and his visits to Iran, Iraq, and Czechoslovakia

arabic_text: ضحك الامتحان.. وسبوفيه! [مسابقة] / كويكر أوتس QuakerOats [إعلان] / سلونز الروماتيزم Sloan's [إعلان]
translation: "Laughter of the Exam… and Suboofih!" — reader-competition text/puzzle with photo of the Quaker Oats mascot / [Top-right ad] Quaker Oats: "Give your children the elongated (tall) growth!" — with two happy children and cereal box illustration / [Middle-right ad] Sloans Liniment: "Rheumatism — how to treat it with Sloan's" with athletic man illustration; "Abu Chibb, friend of the sixties" slogan

arabic_text: ليلة مع الأرواح والأشباح [مقال] / صور الوسيط وهو في الغيبوبة
translation: "A Night with Spirits and Ghosts" — feature/photo essay on a Cairo séance/spiritualist gathering: two photographs of the medium (Al-Waseet) in a trance state, wearing a checked shirt and laid back with eyes closed on a chaise longue; article describes the séance procedures, spirit-summoning rituals, and the audience's reactions

arabic_text: التاج الحزين.. الذي أصبح أثراً / شفرات جيلت الزرقاء Blue Gillette Blades [إعلان] / الربيع - عدد الاثنين خاص [إعلان]
translation: "The Sorrowful Crown… That Became a Relic" — historical feature/essay about the exiled Italian royal family and the abdicated crown (following the 1946 Italian republican referendum); tale of the fate of European royal regalia in a democratic age / [Top-right ad] Blue Gillette Razor Blades: "Even Millionaires Cannot Buy Better!" / [Bottom-right ad] Al-Ithnayn magazine's special summer issue "Al-Rabee" (Spring) — with big illustrated bouquet-holding starlet

arabic_text: فيلسوف أم مجنون؟ [قصة] / في أثناء نومك أسبرو يخلصك من ذلك البرد! - أسبرو Aspro [إعلان دواء]
translation: "Philosopher or Madman?" — short-story/feature: melodramatic account of a strange man who claims great insights but everyone thinks he's mad — with continuation of a boxing-story serial / [Left column full-page ad] "During Your Sleep — Aspro Frees You From That Cold!" — Aspro (aspirin) tablets ad with reclining woman illustration; "Aspro Ends Colds"; L.E. prices; below IKA vanilla milk-chocolate advertisement

arabic_text: لهنا فقرا.. إلى رحمة الله / وامش الصيني - أطعم الصيني.. تصبح على المائدة روحاً جديداً [إعلان] / مجاناً - نصائح لكل الأزواج
translation: "To Us the Poor… Into God's Mercy" — feature/photo essay on Egyptian charity for orphan children: photo of a young girl in white smock being carried on the shoulder of a schoolboy while classmates cheer / [Right ad] Wamashi Chinese-formula cleaning powder — "Feed the Chinese formula onto your table and give a new spirit" / "FREE — Advice for All Husbands!" — sidebar giveaway of a booklet with subscription

arabic_text: قيتو - راديو هورنيفون Horniphon - الاستيلاء [إعلان راديو] / سيرة الديوي
translation: [Left ad] Hornyphon radios — "The Latest Model" — full-page illustration of five different receiver models with prices from L.E. 8.5 to L.E. 39; guaranteed models with Egyptian technical service / [Right column] "Sirat Al-Dewi" (Story of the Uncontrolled) — short satirical story about a young man's day in court on false accusations, with cartoon of the exchange between the judge and the accused

arabic_text: لغة البلاص [صور] - كواكبنا في البلاص - النجمة تحبيبة توفيق
translation: "The Language of Water-Jars" (Lughat Al-Balass) — full-page photo feature: female film star Tahiya Tawfeeq poses in various expressive stances holding traditional Egyptian earthenware water jugs (balass) as if in the folk-style dances of Upper Egypt; three inset photos on pink background at right show her holding the jugs against her hip, on her head, and in mock rural-woman poses; the language of the balass is compared to spoken dialect for expressing emotions

arabic_text: أعيني الزوجين [مقال] / روسوس - البدوية Rossos [إعلان بودرة] / وزارة الأشغال العمومية - مصلحة المكاتيا والكهرباء [إعلان رسمي]
translation: "Ainai Al-Zawjayn" (The Eyes of the Two Spouses) — full-page marital-advice article by Prof. Zaher Sabri: analysis of the different perspectives of husbands and wives on domestic matters, with cartoon of a quarreling couple / [Left ad] ROSSOS Al-Badweya face powder — "The Name Guaranteeing Perfect Quality" — with color drawing of a woman under an ornate scallop-border frame / [Bottom notice] Ministry of Public Works official job vacancy

arabic_text: الأصدقاء الجدد / سنين الأمة [قصة] / احتفن جهاز راديو بهذا السعر - راديو فيليبس Philips [إعلان راديو]
translation: "The New Friends" and "Sanin Al-Umma" (Years of the Nation) — short story feature on new friendships formed in wartime and its impact on society / [Bottom ad] "Buy Any Radio at This Price" — Philips brand radios starting from L.E. 24.30 with drawing of the receiver; guaranteed for 5 years; installment payments; sold at all authorized dealers

arabic_text: فيزا واحدة.. وثلاثون ألف بر! [صور] - حسن عبد الرحيم في محطة إدريس
translation: "One Visa… and Thirty Thousand of Blessings!" — travel feature/photograph: journalist Hassan Abdel Rahim in London at Idlewild Airport (Idris Station in Arabic transliteration) being welcomed by an English hostess in polka-dot dress and a top-hat aide; text describes the shock of English visa procedures and the elaborate British protocol for a returning traveler

arabic_text: العفو! - رد ملاش [قصة] / أير فرانس Air France [إعلان طيران] / شركة توزيع المصنوعات المصرية [إعلان]
translation: "Al-Afou!" (Excuse Me!) — humor sketch with dialogue between an Egyptian gentleman and a European lady on a bus / [Right column ad] The Egyptian Manufactures Distribution Company — Spring sales price-list of imported and Egyptian bank-guaranteed products, with tables of prices for shirts, sheets, and household linens / [Bottom-left ad] AIR FRANCE — with sleek color drawing of a modern airliner in the sky above clouds; "In Every Place, a Superior Service"

arabic_text: الأسبوع في رسوم - كاريكاتيرات الأحداث الأسبوعية
translation: "The Week in Drawings" — full-page political cartoon page divided into four large panels of the week's international news: (top-left) two men swimming with a life-preserver labeled 'Yugoslavia' near Titanic-like sinking ship; (top-right) hand holding up a wine goblet with the map of Africa etched on it; (bottom-left) a hand rising from the sea with sun-rays and 'Egypt' printed on wave; (bottom-right) an American battleship with the Italian tricolor emblem on its bow

arabic_text: مقال الصباح واليوم [افتتاحية] / أطعم فرانسيا Ferrania - قماش [إعلان] / معجون فرانيا [إعلان معجون أسنان] / TWA أمريكا [إعلان]
translation: "Article of the Morning and the Day" — editorial column by the magazine's editor on current politics / [Right column ads] Ferrania Italian film / "Feed on Ferrania" pasta with color noodles and jar illustration / Ferrania toothpaste — with red tube illustration / TWA Airlines to America — with drawing of an American Airlines airliner in flight

arabic_text: إيطاليا في بلاد جديدة! [مقال] / ملح أندروز Andrew's [إعلان] / كيوي Kiwi [إعلان ملمع أحذية]
translation: "Italy in a New Land!" — feature/political article on Italy's post-war reconstruction with photograph of Italian statesmen at a diplomatic reception; text discusses how Italy is emerging from the ruins of fascism / [Right column ad] Andrew's Liver Salt with cutout drawing of a man drinking a glass; "Keep Your Health with the Real Beautiful English Health!" / [Bottom-left ad] KIWI Black Shoe Polish with the Kiwi bird mascot

arabic_text: برلين، موسكو، واشنطن، لندن - رحلة عبر مدن الحرب [مقال مصور]
translation: "Berlin, Moscow, Washington, London" — travel/photo essay on the great capitals of the wartime world with two large photographs: (top) a modern boulevard with double-decker buses and cars; (bottom) sweeping panorama of a war-devastated city center with piles of rubble where buildings once stood; article compares the fates of the Allied and Axis capitals in the aftermath of WWII

arabic_text: غلاف العدد ٨٢٥ - لانا تيرنر Lana Turner [صورة غلاف ملون]
translation: Front cover full-color portrait of blonde Hollywood actress Lana Turner in a red gown showing decolletage, with sharp lipstick and blue eyes; sepia-blue-gradient background; magazine issue no. 825, Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Dunya, dated 3 April 1950, published in Cairo/Egypt/Sudan; price 20 milliemes; pink Al-Ithnayn crescent logo top-right

arabic_text: طاردت الأنقاض! [قصة] / مجاناً - نصائح للوالدين - كل من عرض على الزواج [إعلان مجاني] / جينومين Jinomin [إعلان دواء] / بامكو - بلمود [إعلان حقائب]
translation: "Al-Angadh Wa Tardat!" (I Was Followed by Debris!) — comic short story with cartoon of a lawyer being cornered by ruffians in his office / [Right ad] "FREE — Advice for Parents — for everyone who is offered marriage" — free booklet with subscription / [Ad] Genumin nerve tonic capsules for men / [Bottom-right ad] BAMKO BALMUDE briefcases in 8 colors with skin trim, L.E. 2.95, sold in Cairo, Alexandria, and Port Said

arabic_text: مدينة الطلاق في الصيف - رينو - أمير قتان [مقال سفر]
translation: "The City of Divorce in the Summer" — travel article by Prof. Ameer Qattan: report on the American resort city of Reno, Nevada — famous for quick divorces; large photograph in the middle shows well-dressed men and women at a casino gambling-table with roulette wheel; text describes the divorce laws of Nevada and the summer flock of couples seeking marital dissolution

arabic_text: لا يعجبني في أبي! [مقال] - كريمة اللواء أحمد نشأت باشا - الآنسة زكية
translation: "What I Don't Like About My Father!" — feature/interview: Princess Zakia (daughter of Field Marshal Ahmed Nashat Pasha) frankly discusses what she wishes her father would change; large photograph of her elegantly posed against a black lettered banner spelling out the title; a candid Egyptian teenage-daughter's perspective on paternal habits

arabic_text: بريد القلوب [عمود نصائح] / حسن.. الطارة / زوج.. من لبنان / زوجته.. الإسماعيلية / مصوغات الجمل [إعلان]
translation: "Mail of the Hearts" — advice column: responses to reader questions about marriage, courtship, and family relations, each addressed by pseudonym like Hasna Al-Tara (from the countryside), a Lebanese husband, an Ismailia housewife, etc. / [Right ad] Jamal jewelry: "Wear it with the best of blessings" with woman-in-earrings illustration

arabic_text: المتحف العربي - كاريكاتير سياسي عن حلوان [كاريكاتير سياسي كبير ملون]
translation: "The Arab Museum" — full-page political cartoon in color: a shrewish woman (labeled 'shariket al-Sharaa' — the Company of the Streets) piled on a couch with distraught bearded politicians (turbaned sheikhs, tarbouche-wearing effendis) sitting around her being scolded; balloons rise labeled 'Palestine', 'Wailat Israel', etc.; caption "The Last Show at the Ice Exhibition… Result?!" — satirizes the Arab League's disorganized response to the 1948 war

arabic_text: شهادة دار الهلال - محاسبون قانونيون RUSSELL & CO. [صورة شهادة رسمية]
translation: Full-page reproduction of an official certificate from Russell & Co. Chartered Accountants (P.O. Box 445, Graham House, Sharia Sulaiman Pasha, Cairo, dated 31 January 1950): certifying the print-run and distribution statistics of Al-Hilal's magazines — showing the huge circulation of Al-Ithnayn magazine; red bordering commentary at the bottom explains: "Every year at the start of the year we publish the statement of our circulation numbers to advertisers and readers"

arabic_text: قصة الأسبوع - إمبراطورية النساء [قصة خيال علمي] - الأستاذ أحمد جلال
translation: "Story of the Week — The Empire of Women" — sci-fi short story by Prof. Ahmed Galal (the writer of Bunyan Al-Mareef): a dystopian tale set in the future, where robotic men and human women rule a world in which men have gone extinct; large cartoon-illustration at the bottom shows women elegantly dressed on thrones surveilling ranks of robots; explores the dread of feminism and mechanization

arabic_text: قصة قصيرة - رسم توضيحي لزوجين على أريكة
translation: Full-page illustrated short-story page — large color drawing of a young couple embracing on a plush red-and-orange tufted sofa: a handsome man in navy blazer leaning toward a red-haired woman in white lace top with elaborate frills, gesturing tenderly to hold hands; text continues from previous page a melodrama of marital reconciliation

arabic_text: كلام.. وحديث / اضحك معي.. / اشرب معي / حكمة الأسبوع [عمود فكاهي]
translation: "Kalam wa Hadith" (Talk and Conversation) — full-page double-spread humor collage: 'Laugh With Me' jokes column, 'Drink With Me' café-gossip column, 'Wisdom of the Week' column, and cartoons of café characters — a large cartoon of a group of men in fez arguing at a Cairo café; family-humor cartoons; 'Definitions of Ordinariness' satirical wordplay

arabic_text: مدرسة كوبري الليمون الابتدائية - أولى مدارسها في الشهادة الابتدائية [إعلان] / للبيع - مصعد للبضاعة [إعلان صغير]
translation: [Full-page ad] Kobri Al-Limun Elementary School (in Damardash Gardens on King Street) — "First among its schools for the Elementary Certificate" — announces the school's excellent exam results with photos; classes start 16 September; enrolments open; new campus with all modern facilities / [Bottom-right classified ad] "For Sale — Goods Elevator" — like new, moderate price, can be converted to standard passenger lift; all fittings included; contact via Dar Al-Hilal

arabic_text: بطل على الدغم منه [قصة] - رسم توضيحي لحارس بندقية في حقل ذرة
translation: "A Hero on the Darkness" (Batl Ala Al-Dhalam Minhu) — full-page short story continuation with large ink-drawing of a young man in prison-striped shirt kneeling in a cornfield holding up a rifle at gun-point; melodrama of a village conflict with wounded honor and revenge

arabic_text: العظماء السبعة.. الذين عرفتهم! - مصطفى كامل، محمد فريد، سعد زغلول، الملك فؤاد الأول، الملك فيصل - بقلم الدكتور محمود عزمي [مقال]
translation: "The Seven Great Ones… Whom I Knew!" — historical/political memoir by Dr. Mahmoud Azmy — profiles of the seven great Egyptian statesmen he had personally met: (1) King Fuad I; (2) King Faisal; (3) Mustafa Kamel; (4) Muhammad Fareed; (5) Saad Zaghloul, [6 and 7 continued next issue]; portrait photographs of King Fuad I and King Faisal

arabic_text: هل تؤمن بالسحر؟ [مقال] / أمير الدهاء - إعلان فيلم / حالياً بسينما متروبول
translation: "Do You Believe in Magic?" — full-page feature-essay on Egyptian superstitions with cartoon of a couple at a fortune-teller's parlour; text discusses hypnotism, spiritualism, and how educated Egyptians still cling to these beliefs / [Left column ad] "Ameer Al-Daha'" (Prince of Cunning) — new Egyptian film starring Yusef Wahby, Elsie Weiler, Fatima Rushdi — showing at Sinama Metropol, with prize L.E. 1,500

arabic_text: قصة فارسية - قطرة من العسل - قصة مصورة
translation: "Persian Story — A Drop of Honey" — full-page illustrated Persian folk-tale: color drawing of an old shopkeeper in Persian robe with red fez trying to persuade a glamorous 1940s Western-styled woman in a red pointed hat and short-sleeved red dress to buy honey; whimsical cartoon accompanies the moral fable about the beekeeper, the sultan, and the drop of honey that caused a war; column at right on cinema-comedy news

arabic_text: أحسن وأغرب صورهم - لمشاهير المصورين [صور نجمات]
translation: "Their Best and Strangest Portraits — By Famous Photographers" — full double-page collage of avant-garde celebrity portraits: (top-left) a laughing double-portrait of two sisters (Nawal Zayd); (top-middle) sepia legs-only portrait; (top-right) sepia dreamy woman in reverie; (bottom-left) a rag-doll named 'Al-Kalb Al-Ari' (the Naked Dog); (bottom-middle-right) three haunting portraits including 'Dahayat al-Ghana' (Victim of Song) and a woman cradling a striped cat

arabic_text: أنت في حاجة دائمة إليه.. صابون روضة Rawda [إعلان] / برما ساعات Burma [إعلان]
translation: [Full-page ad] Rawda soap: "You Are in Constant Need of It" — with four oval-frame illustrations of daily uses of the soap; net weight 100 grams, 6 piasters; Nikolakis-Bey Al-Kahla Egyptian Soap Factories; "With every 6 pieces get one bar free, 150 grams, 15 milliemes" / [Bottom-left ad] Burma watches, sunglasses, and medical eyewear

arabic_text: بودرة ميرانده Mirande [إعلان] / للسيدات - مفصل فاروق [إعلان محل خياطة] / الكيك سراس في الصحراء [صور فيلم]
translation: [Left column ad] Mirande face powder — dramatic black-and-white close-up photo of a woman applying the powder from a small mirror-lid box / [Left column ad] For Ladies — Farouk Salon fashion boutique for latest 1945 Cologne and dress styles / [Right column] "The Circus Serious in the Desert" — feature/photo essay on North Africa desert war soldiers entertained by circus performers: photos of soldiers around an accordion-player, plus scenes of desert combat

arabic_text: سحابة صيف.. - الدكتور أحمد زكي بك [مقال] - الأميرة سلطة عبد الرحمن
translation: "Sahabat Sayf!" (A Summer Cloud!) — feature article by Dr. Ahmed Zaki Bey: photograph of Princess Sulta Abdel Rahman (widow of King Abdullah I of Jordan) at a formal reception being greeted by dignitaries at the Idris Airport in her elegant fur-trimmed black jacket; inset portrait of the Princess; article on how the Prince Nayef of Jordan wedding took the Cairo social scene by storm

arabic_text: جالا أوف لندن - كريم شفاء ليب لاين Leep-Lyne [إعلان كريم]
translation: [Left column ad] "Gala of London — Leep-Lyne Lip Balm" — new colored lip-heal cream from London imported by Farmacia in Cairo; the ad shows a hand holding a pen writing the words in fanciful calligraphy on the page and rows of pink lipstick tubes; also touts 'Al-Nabl Al-Ward' (the arrow of the rose) magical lipstick with 10 shades / [Right side] Feature/photo of a village welcoming a visiting dignitary at the village mayor's residence

arabic_text: فلسطينية.. تتوج ملكة في بيروت! [مقال] - الآنسة السي، ملكة جمال بيروت
translation: "A Palestinian… Crowned Queen in Beirut!" — feature: Miss L. (Al-Sa'i), a Lebanese/Palestinian young lady, was crowned Miss Beirut/Miss Lebanon at a Beirut beauty pageant; the newly-crowned queen elegantly poses in evening gown and thigh-length skirt in a large portrait photograph, with inset photos of her being handed the diadem by the Lebanese Minister of National Education; text tells of the glamorous evening

arabic_text: كل شائق وطريف يجدونه في مجلة الكواكب - سينما ومسرح [إعلان] / حكايات على الماشي [عمود صحفي]
translation: [Left column full-page ad] Al-Kawakib magazine promotion: "Every enthusiast and enthralling finds it in Al-Kawakib magazine — Cinema and Theater" — with color close-up portrait of a blonde starlet and stars-and-stripes edging; released 10 May; 100 pages; 5 piasters; issue theme: "Al-Hebba Al-Fahera" (The Gorgeous Necklace); starring Robert Taylor / [Right column] "Anecdotes on the Go" — journalist's travel-vignettes column

arabic_text: أمتن دراجة في مصر - رالي RALEIGH [إعلان دراجة] / مقلوب.. رسمي / حديث العمدة
translation: [Right column ad] RALEIGH — "The Most Solid Bicycle in Egypt" — with illustration of the black bicycle; "The All-Steel Bicycle — Sold in the Egyptian Market Everywhere" — Sturmey-Archer 3-speed model, product of Nottingham, England — from L.E. 8 / [Right column] "Maqloub… Rasmi" (Officially Overturned) satirical column / [Bottom right] "The Village Mayor's Talk" humor column continuation

arabic_text: صاحب معامل زجاج الساعات فايز للسكر - لبيب أفندي محمد / اكتشاف جديد في عالم الأناقة - رفعت وأنور [إعلان] / صحابي كل يوم بمهرة أفكار اهنه [إعلان قرآن]
translation: [Top-right ad] Personal/business notice: portrait photo of Labib Effendi Muhammad, owner of a watch-repair and watch-crystal factory; announces newly opened service outlet at Suq No. 27, Musky, Cairo / [Right column] Advertisement box for a recently discovered Quran-copy with ornate illuminated Quranic pages (2 photos); "Rafat and Anwar" fashion boutique; and other Islamic devotional items and stationery

arabic_text: هل نغني الحرب / إصابات الحمى بالمصادف - يمكنيها ماكيا حجمك - أسبرو Aspro [إعلان] / خفايا الدنيا [عمود]
translation: "Do We Sing the War?" — political-critique column: Egyptian intellectuals debate whether to make patriotic-war songs given Egypt's status in WWII / [Right column ad] "Sudden Fever Attacks — Beware!" — Aspro (aspirin) tablets ad with anxious-looking male portrait / [Bottom-right] "Khafaya Al-Dunya" (Secrets of the World) — political-espionage column

arabic_text: غلاف العدد ٨٣٦ - بشم النسيم - نجمة بجلابية ملونة تحت كرات ملونة [صورة غلاف ملون]
translation: Front cover full-color photograph of a smiling brunette woman lying with her chin resting on hands amid a bed of dozens of multicolored balloons (blue, red, yellow, orange, green); yellow ribbon-banner top-right says "Sham Al-Nessim" (Egyptian spring festival); magazine issue no. 836, Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Dunya, dated 17 April 1950, published in Cairo/Egypt/Sudan; price 20 milliemes; "You could win the small car — enter now" prize contest banner bottom-right

arabic_text: كلام.. وحديث [صفحة فكاهة] / معي الفلوس [كاريكاتير]
translation: "Talk and Conversation" — full-page humor collage on faded pink background: multiple humor columns with orange-red decorative headers; cartoon of a robber holding up a policeman; large panel cartoon of a battered husband stumbling home in the rain; small orange sun-and-cloud illustration; interior joke definitions and one-liners about marriage, exams, and civil service life

arabic_text: أستاذنا الذي علمناه! [مقال] - بقلم السيدة أمينة السعيد
translation: "Our Teacher Whom We Educated!" — full-page memoir by Amina Al-Saeed (leading feminist journalist): humorous reminiscence of a schoolteacher's foibles; central illustration is a group of turbaned old teachers gathered around a chalkboard and stepladder in a monochrome brown color-scheme; text describes how the students unwittingly educated their eccentric master in modern manners

arabic_text: خاتم الأميد [قصة] - إذا تآمرت الظروف على شخص برى أظهرته بمظاهر الفارق في الذنوب
translation: "Khatem Al-Umeed" (The Ring of Hope) — short-story feature with humorous cartoons in the margins: illustrated on a coral-pink background with sketches of a police officer, a man with a suitcase, a man in prison, a young effendi behind bars; whimsical tale of a wrongly accused innocent man tracing his misfortunes

arabic_text: صنفه دائماً كالجنيه وثمنه لم يزد إلا قرشاً - نابلسي فاروق - صابون [إعلان] / سيارات عطاطة [إعلان]
translation: [Full-page ad] Nabulsi Farouk soap — features a large detailed illustration of a National Bank of Egypt one-pound banknote crossed by a bar of soap; slogan: "Classified always as the pound — the price only rose by one piaster"; 100% pure olive-oil; 6 piasters per bar / [Bottom ad] Attata Cars — auto dealer

arabic_text: ضحكات هذا الأسبوع - المفاوضات [عمود] / براحة.. برد منش - إنه الطريقة اليمانية للنظام الباطن - أندروس Andrews [إعلان]
translation: "Laughs of This Week — The Negotiations" — political-satire column on the ongoing Anglo-Egyptian treaty negotiations / [Right full-page ad] Andrew's Liver Salt: "With Restfulness — Cold Refreshment — the Yemenite Way for Inner Order" — with photo of a smiling woman drinking a tall glass of the effervescent water; large text and Andrews Salt jar illustrations

arabic_text: ساعتان ونصف في الجنة - بنت باريز [إعلان فيلم] / وزارة المالية / أير فرانس Air France [إعلان]
translation: [Top ad] "Two and a Half Hours in Paradise — Bint Bariz" (Daughter of Paris) — new Egyptian musical film starring Mimi Sherif, Zubaida, Suleiman Naguib, Farid Al-Attrash; at Sinama Metropol / [Middle ad] Ministry of Finance official notice/tender for stationery / [Bottom-left ad] AIR FRANCE — silver airliner illustration over clouds; "Everywhere, Superior Service"

arabic_text: مباراة في الكذب! [قصة] - إنسان المرأة! / ناقوس العدالة [قصة مصورة]
translation: "A Competition in Lying!" — full-page short story with a humorous cartoon of two elegant Cairo ladies chatting on a boulevard, wearing modish 1950s dresses (one in white flared skirt, one in dark jacket-and-red-neckerchief); story of two friends who compete in outrageous social boasting / "Naqoos Al-Adala" (The Bell of Justice) — illustrated crime story continuation

arabic_text: بطل على الدغم - بقية القصة / برما - ساعات ومجوهرات ونظارات طبية Burma [إعلان] / بوتر [إعلان دواء]
translation: "Hero on the Darkness — Continuation of the Story" — final installment of last week's story with cartoon in the corner of a group of policemen investigating a crime scene / [Right column ad] BURMA — watches, jewelry, and medical eyewear — from 7 Nadi Fuad First Street, Alexandria / [Bottom-left ad] POTTER'S catarrh pastilles: "Have You Colds?" — for coughs and throat congestion

arabic_text: اضاء الطروب.. وجه جديد / الراديو اليوم لا يوض بأربعة صالح النسيم [إعلان راديو] / لم تصر وتصعدي وحن ابرك ذر؟ [إعلان طعام] / حالياً أوكازيون عماد الدين - تصفية بلا رفيقة [إعلان]
translation: "Adayat Al-Tarob" (Illuminations of the Elegant) — new-face column: reader-submitted photos of glamorous social debutantes / [Right column ads] Al-Radio Al-Yowm modern receivers, Sadeq Al-Naseem Frigidaire; food-storage refrigerator with drawing of woman shopping; a men's suit sale; and "Now Now Emad Al-Din — Blowout Clearance Without Friends" ad with megaphone-shouting mascot

arabic_text: هوليوود مصر - أول مرة على مسرح كازينو وبرا [عمود] / سينما راديو - الزوجة السابعة [إعلان فيلم]
translation: [Left column film ad] "Sinama Radio: Al-Zawja Al-Sabi'a" (The Seventh Wife) — new Egyptian comedy film starring Mary Kwini, Muhammad Fawzy, Suleiman Naguib, Shadia; directed by Ibrahim Emara; distributed by Aflam Misr, at Sinama Misr and Sinama Rex / [Right column] "Hoolywood Misr" (Egyptian Hollywood) column: preview of the summer's first "opera on stage" at Casino Opera with the star-cast unveiled

arabic_text: ١٠٠٠ طلقة نار في زفاف وزير المالية! [صور احتفال] - زفاف الدكتور زكي عبد المتعال / كعكة الأعراس - سلاح رجال الصعيد
translation: "1,000 Gunshots at the Wedding of the Minister of Finance!" — feature/photo essay: (top) large photo of the al-Sudan-al-Ithnayn wedding party with the maulids musicians and dancers on the terrace under the pergola with a full band; (bottom) close-up photo of the bride and groom cutting the giant wedding cake; groom is Dr. Zaki Abdel Muta'al (Minister of Finance); text describes the traditional Upper Egyptian celebration with rifle-fire

arabic_text: بقية القصة - رسم توضيحي لخيال / نساء زوج
translation: Full-page short-story continuation illustrated with a corner ink-drawing of a horseback rider in the mist under a dark cloud; narrative continuation of a marital-strife story that began several pages earlier; text weaves between the perspectives of a husband and wife caught in a domestic misunderstanding, with fragmented italicized dialogue passages

arabic_text: العربية [كاريكاتير سياسي كبير ملون] - السويدي باشا: تفكروا إنه راح بغدر بستني [العرب في البحر]
translation: "Al-Arabiyya" (The Arab League) — full-page color political cartoon: a group of Arab statesmen (in fez, turban, keffiyeh) stand on a dry patch as a red sea labeled 'Al-Arabiyya' floods around them, with one drowning in the water; caption from El-Suwaidy Pasha of Iraq: "They think he went ahead to promise Palestine…" — satirizes Arab League disunity in the aftermath of the 1948 Nakba

arabic_text: ماذا للشعب؟ - الدكتور حسين مؤنس [مقال سياسي]
translation: "What for the People?" — political essay by Dr. Hussein Mo'nis: full-page article criticizing the government's spending priorities; illustrated with a scene of Cairo (drawing of turbaned man with rifle in a palm-tree village); argues government should invest in public services (water, hospitals, schools) not palaces and grand boulevards; asks why nothing is done despite abundant tax revenues

arabic_text: صور الأقطاب.. (بقية) / السيد رشدي، الملك حسين، الدكتور بشرزيلي، الأميرة نيلي ماري / رشدي آراس / لور برذرز LEVER BROTHERS - سنلايت [إعلان]
translation: "Portraits of the Great Ones" (continuation) — political-memoir portraits: (top-right) young King Hussein of Jordan photograph; commentary on Egyptian, Jordanian, Iraqi statesmen; SS Frontier ambassadors; Princess Neli Marie / [Ads] Lever Brothers Port Said soap works; Sunlight soap; and Rushdi Aras (Turkish Foreign Minister) portrait and article

arabic_text: هوليوود مصر - حسين صدقي يحارب المخدرات! [مقال] / أختي ستينة [إعلان فيلم]
translation: "Hollywood Misr — Hussein Sidki Fights Drugs!" — cinema-industry feature on Egyptian film star Hussein Sidki's new anti-drug propaganda film 'Tareek Al-Sulook' (The Path of Behavior); portrait photo of Sidki in police uniform; large behind-the-scenes photograph at bottom of the shooting of 'Ukhti Setina' (My Sister Setina) at Sinama Nahas with Sabah Hussein Fawzy, Wasfi Abdel Wahab; smaller stills of the film's key scenes

arabic_text: حكمة الطويقة! - رعية الأسطورة - الأستاذ حبيب جاماتي [مقال]
translation: "Hikmet Al-Tariqa!" (Wisdom of the Way!) — full-page article by Prof. Habib Jamati recounting a Chinese/Japanese folk legend: large color drawing at top illustrates the story — a Japanese prince in traditional dress sitting under a cherry blossom tree conversing with an elegantly kimono-clad Japanese princess who holds a red-and-gold decorated lantern; text is an allegory on marriage, jealousy, and the folly of hasty judgments

arabic_text: غلاف العدد ٨٢٧ - وجه امرأة من الأزهار والأوراق [صورة غلاف فنية ملونة]
translation: Front cover full-color surrealist illustration: a stylized ivory-toned female face composed of a collage of flowers, leaves, and greenery — the eyes are green leaves, the mouth ruby-red, and the coiffure and shoulders formed of layered blossoms and greenery; magazine issue no. 827, Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Dunya, dated 17 April 1950 (Sham Al-Nessim spring-festival issue); price 20 milliemes; yellow diamond bottom-right shows the car-lottery prize illustration

arabic_text: الأستاذ فوزي المواعي في فلسطين - القائد فوزي القاوقجي مع مساعديه في جبهة الأشداء / حراسة الحدود العربية [صور من الحرب في فلسطين]
translation: "Prof. Fawzy Al-Mawa'i in Palestine" — full-page war-correspondent feature/photo essay: (top-left) large photo of a fighter in keffiyeh with rifle and a bareheaded man leading a horse; (top-middle) group of Arab fighters in cold-weather uniforms crouching around a campfire in a rocky field; (top-right) Fawzy Al-Qawuqji (commander of the Arab Liberation Army) holding a rifle beside a keffiyeh-wearing officer; article on the Arab Liberation Army's Palestine border operations, mountain-guerrilla warfare against Zionist forces, and Al-Qawuqji's role as field commander of the volunteers coming to Palestine

arabic_text: في سنة ١٩٣٩ كانت ستة جنيهات تكفي الرجل أن يكون أنيقاً / أما في سنة ١٩٤٨ - نصائح للاقتصاد في الأزمة
translation: "In 1939, Six Pounds Were Enough for a Man to Be Elegant! / But In 1948…" — full-page fashion/economics feature satirizing the rising cost of a proper wardrobe due to inflation: (top-left) photo of a well-dressed young effendi in full three-piece dark suit and tarbouche; (top-right) two side-by-side line drawings — a suited man and a shirtless man in trousers — labeled with 1939 and 1948 pricing; (bottom-left) photo of the same young man now in shirt-sleeves, tie, waistcoat and shorts; text on the right recommends economies for the reader in 1948 — jacket alone, shirt alone with waistcoat, or just trousers-tie-shirt combinations depending on the wallet

arabic_text: كيف تختبئين يا سيدتي؟ - بقلم البانو روزفلت [مقال] / شمشون والجبار [إعلان فيلم] - سراج منير، هاجر حمدي، محمود المليجي، مديحة يسري - سعاد مكاوي
translation: "How Do You Hide, My Lady?" — women's-column feature (translated into Arabic) by Eleanor Roosevelt ("al-Banoo Roosevelt") on women's coping strategies in wartime — a light philosophical essay about resilience and grace under pressure / [Left column film ad] "Shamshoon wa Al-Jabbar" (Samson and the Mighty One) — new Egyptian film premiering 22 March at Studio Misr Cairo, starring Siraj Munir, Hajir Hamdi, Mahmoud El-Meligy, Madeeha Yousry, Sa'ad Makawi; photograph shows the biblical strong-man cast in dramatic scene

arabic_text: بطلة وقصة.. - الأستاذ وليم أسيل [قصة قصيرة] - رسم توضيحي لطبيب وامرأة
translation: "A Heroine and a Story…" — short story by Prof. William Asyl: full-page ink-drawing of a young female patient in white lace nightgown and a doctor with stethoscope leaning close to her by a bedside table; melodrama about a doctor entangled with a beautiful patient — the kind of scenarios life presents that can outmatch fantasy

arabic_text: موعد غرامي! [قصة] - نجيب الريحاني / مجلة الشباب - سياسة، اجتماع، رياضة، استكشاف، أدب [إعلان] / بريتيش جلاندلار BRITISH GLANDULAR PRODUCTS [إعلان دواء]
translation: "A Romantic Rendezvous!" — feature/short story reminiscing about Naguib El-Rihani (the great Egyptian comedic actor-playwright); ink illustration and portrait / [Left column ads] Al-Shabab magazine subscription — "Politics, Society, Sports, Exploration, Literature" with muscular male silhouette; British Glandular Products London — Gland (organic-substance) hormone therapy sold at all Egyptian pharmacies

arabic_text: أنا عندي ميعاد.. مع جوان ليزلي! [مقال هوليوود] - جوان ليزلي [صورة نجمة]
translation: "I Have a Date… with Joan Leslie!" — full-page Hollywood-gossip feature: large photo of American actress Joan Leslie smiling, hand at cheek, wearing a black polka-dot blouse; article describes her habits, favourite outings, and her fiance — the perfect Hollywood-lady-next-door portrait

arabic_text: اضحك في ظرفاء رمضان.. [عمود فكاهي] / في قافية رمضان / قافية الأوديك / قافية العباس
translation: "Laugh in the Wit of Ramadan!" — Ramadan humor column full-page: top photo of three men in white galabiyas laughing at a table (Yousef Wahby and other actors); bottom photo of a large crowd of men sitting around cheering for their favorite comedian's punchline; word-play columns 'Ramadan Rhyme', 'Al-Odek Rhyme', 'Al-Abbas Rhyme' — political and social jokes in rhyming couplets

arabic_text: الجنس اللطيف.. تحت الميكروسكوب! - الدكتور مظهر سعيد (عميد التربية وعلم النفس بوزارة المعارف) [صور تجارب]
translation: "The Gentle Sex… Under the Microscope!" — full-page psychology-experiment feature by Dr. Muzhar Saeed (Dean of Education and Psychology at the Ministry of Education): eight-panel photograph grid of a young woman (Fatima) in various body-language poses — smoking a cigarette elegantly, sitting on a couch with legs crossed, one leg over the arm, reclining sideways, etc.; captions ask readers to psychologize each pose to guess her personality

arabic_text: غلاف العدد ٧٤٦ - فرانسيس جيفورد Frances Gifford (نجمة هوليوود) - نتيجة شهر أكتوبر ١٩٤٨ - هدية [صورة غلاف ملون]
translation: Front cover full-color glamour portrait of Hollywood actress Frances Gifford in an ivory silk blouse looking coquettishly over her bare shoulder with bright lipstick and pearl earrings; magazine issue no. 746, Al-Ithnayn wa Al-Dunya, dated 27 September 1948; the yellow-red banner promises "October 1948 Calendar as a GIFT!" with issue; 20 milliemes

arabic_text: هوليوود الكواكب مصر [عمود] / تامارا Tamara - صابون / كوينوس Kolynos [إعلان معجون أسنان] / بريد كريم Brylcreem [إعلان]
translation: "Hollywood Al-Kawakib Misr" (Egyptian Star Hollywood) column: photo of a female singer at the microphone singing a new hit for the elite; text on the new Egyptian musical productions of the season / [Left column ads] Kolynos Dental Cream: "Clean your teeth with generous-lather Kolynos toothpaste"; Tamara soap "Tamara Ltd. London-Egypt-New York"

arabic_text: اثنين اثنين.. على الشاطئ! [صور شاطئ]
translation: "Ithnayn Ithnayn… Ala Al-Shatee!" (Two-by-Two on the Beach!) — full-page beach photo essay: (top) large candid photograph of a young woman leaning back from a canoe/rowboat prow at Alexandria's beach; (bottom-left) sepia photo of a woman posing on the shoulders of a swimming friend; (bottom-right) fortune-teller sitting cross-legged on the beach reading the palm of a young lady — the summer's love-and-leisure vignettes

arabic_text: جواز نابلسي فاروق - جوائز مالية ٥٠ جنيه [إعلان مسابقة] / جحا في حصة الفلسفة
translation: [Left column ad] Nabulsi Farouk soap coupons prize contest: keep coupons, win L.E. 50 monthly prize with each Nabulsi soap package (100% olive-oil, 8 piasters); last day 15 October 1948 / [Right column] "Juha in the Philosophy Class" — humor column with dialogue between the Muslim folk-hero Juha and a philosophy professor

arabic_text: يسكرونهم ثم يدفنونهم أحياء! [قصة فرعونية] - الأستاذ عرب كامل بك
translation: "They Get Them Drunk and Then Bury Them Alive!" — Pharaonic historical-drama short story by Prof. Arab Kamel Bey: full-page color drawing depicts an ancient Egyptian burial ceremony — palace slaves (mostly beautiful women) being drugged and about to be entombed alive with their deceased ruler; text explores the dark rituals of Ptolemaic and pharaonic kingship, with dialogue between courtiers and doomed servants

arabic_text: كنا هناك في المريخ! [قصة خيال علمي] - قصة الجذور، ذكرى أباظة، كرمنكه.. غياضي
translation: "We Were There on Mars!" — full double-page sci-fi tale printed on tinted red and cream background with imaginative graphic design: (top-left) rocket illustration with three men in tarbouches waving; (middle) planets and comets illustrations weaving through the columns; three co-authored contributions about an imagined Egyptian journey to Mars, satirizing bureaucratic delays and terrestrial politics as viewed from space

arabic_text: أخبار العالم - رشيد.. اديان.. أشو أفانوف الإسرائيلي.. أرثويوما - نجوم من هوليوود [مقال]
translation: "World News" — Hollywood-and-international-affairs column: full-page glamour portrait of a Hollywood actress in fur-collared coat with bracelet-cuffs; column below reports on Rashid, Adele, Shaw Ivanov (a Russian actor), Arthur Youma, and Miley Cyprus among other stars; anecdotes about wartime American star morale-boosting for GIs; Frank Sinatra's wartime story

arabic_text: الرجل السعيد..! [قصة] / بريلكريم Brylcreem [إعلان] / سينما رويال - اطلعوني - الاثنين ١٩ يوليو - جهاد قصر التكيف [إعلان فيلم]
translation: "The Happy Man!" — full-page short story: illustration of a sultan on his throne being lectured by his ministers, with sample of the story's key exchange in a wisdom-and-wits parable; text is a folk-tale of a sultan seeking the happy man / [Right column ads] BRYLCREEM: "The Best Treatment for the Trouble of the Hair" — with man-with-slick-hair illustration and packet on-page; Sinama Royal — "Utla'oni" (Watch Me!) — Monday 19 July premiere: "Jihad Qasr Al-Takyif" (Adaptation Palace Struggle) new Egyptian film

arabic_text: أقاويل.. لم تكن السبب! [قصة مصورة]
translation: "Aqawil… Lam Takun Al-Sabab!" (Whispered Words… Were Not the Cause!) — full-page melodrama short story: large sepia ink-drawing of a young woman in dark dress being chastised by an older bearded man leaning aggressively toward her (father figure); dramatic domestic scene; text continues a serial about a marriage crisis caused by malicious village gossip

arabic_text: فتاة وبطتها [صور] - قصة الفتاة الأمريكية وبطتها إبتها
translation: "Girl and Her Duck!" — full-page human-interest photo essay: (top) large photo of an American-street scene with a young girl walking her pet duck across a police-directed intersection; (bottom-left) close-up of the young girl kissing the fluffy white duck; (bottom-right) two smaller photos — the girl feeding the duck and the duck sipping from a bowl at her feet — tale of how the friendship between a New York girl and her pet duck became a media sensation

arabic_text: الرد خالص [قصة قصيرة] / الروح والجسد [إعلان فيلم] - محمد فوزي، شادية، عبد الفتاح القصري، فؤاد شفيق، كمال الشناوي، خلود وفيقة - إخراج أحمد بدرخان
translation: "Al-Rad Khaless" (The Return Answer) — short story on a full page / [Left column film ad] "Al-Rooh wa Al-Jasad" (The Spirit and the Body) — new Egyptian film starring Muhammad Fawzy, Shadia, Abdel Fatah Al-Qasri, Fouad Shafik, Kamal El-Shinnawy, Kholoud Wafiqa; directed by Ahmed Badrakhan; premiering 4 October Sinama Rivoli Cairo, 11 October Sinama Metro Alexandria, 18 October Sinama Farouk in Ismailia

arabic_text: ثلاجات كهربائية تباع في ألمانيا بأسعار شعبية.. وتباع في مصر بأسعار شعبية وبالتقسيط المريح أيضاً! - شركة شاهر [إعلان ثلاجات]
translation: [Full-page ad] "Electric Refrigerators Sold in Germany at Popular Prices… and Sold in Egypt Also at Popular Prices with Comfortable Installments!" — Shaher Company German-imported refrigerators: illustration of a large fridge with the door open surrounded by soft-drink bottles, food, and produce; price list from L.E. 60 cash; installment plan L.E. 6.5 monthly for 12 months; models from 195 to 63 liters; sold at showrooms in Cairo, Alexandria, and Port Said

arabic_text: البائع الطواف والنمر - قصة قصيرة / جهاز ماسون بيسان لالتقاط الإذاعات الأربع في العالم [إعلان راديو] / دلكي صدرك بمرهم الأجيار - جمال الصدر بيسمر ستار [إعلان مرهم]
translation: "The Wandering Vendor and the Tiger" — short story: dramatic ink-drawing of a Bedouin figure crouched among rocks with a tiger prowling on his back; adventure-tale of a desert traveler encountering the beast / [Left column ads] Mason Bisan radio receiver — "The device that captures the four world broadcasts"; "Star" chest cream: "Star chest cream — for a beautiful bosom" with pinup illustration

arabic_text: سباق ميرة محمد علي الكبير - يانصيب مسابقة [إعلان] / عادت جميع طائراتنا [عمود]
translation: [Full-page ad] "Sibaq Mira Muhammad Ali Al-Kabir" — Grand Muhammad Ali Race Lottery — with prize of L.E. 10,000 first prize + car; illustration of a jockey on a colorful racing horse; sponsored by 'Yowm Al-Mustashfiyat' (Hospitals Day) fundraiser / [Right column] "'Adat Jamee' Ta'iratna" (All Our Airplanes Returned) — political-news commentary column on the Egyptian air force's operations

arabic_text: بريد القراء [عمود] / كتب سمير الشابعة [إعلان] / بيولاكسين [إعلان دواء] / تانجي Tangee - مع بومال شعمل [إعلان أحمر شفاه]
translation: "Bareed Al-Qurra" (Reader Mail) — advice/opinion column responding to reader questions on politics, marriage, and lifestyle / [Right column ads] Bulaxen laxative; Al-Shabab Al-Sha'ita — teenager magazine subscription for the summer; Tangee lipstick — "With Pomegranate Wax" — with woman-in-hat illustration; Esterbrook fountain pens; Filadelges Restaurant classified ad

arabic_text: قدماء المصريين كانوا يرقصون في الجنازات! [مقال] - راقصات فرعونية عند الأبى الهول والأهرام
translation: "The Ancient Egyptians Danced at Their Funerals!" — full double-page archaeological/photo-essay feature: light-blue background with Egyptian hieroglyphic silhouettes of dancers and musicians across the top; four large photographs of a modern belly-dancer costumed as an ancient Egyptian priestess performing beside the Sphinx and the Pyramids of Giza — recreating scenes of ancient funerary dance; text explains the ritual dance in ancient Egyptian burial ceremonies

arabic_text: من القصص الإنجليزي - مقلب صيفي! [قصة قصيرة] - رسم توضيحي لثنائي على شاطئ
translation: "From the English Stories — A Summer Practical Joke!" — translated English short story: full-page color illustration on tan/sepia background — a young man in red swimming trunks lounging on a beach beside a young woman in swim cap on his lap and a beach-umbrella in the sun; playful summer-holiday tale with a plot twist about mistaken identity between two friends on a Riviera vacation

arabic_text: غلاف العدد ٧٠٧ - سوزان هيوارد Susan Hayward - نتيجة يناير ١٩٤٨ [صورة غلاف ملون]

translation: "The Beauty of Your Eyes" — illustrated beauty column for women showing six sketches of different eye shapes (round, almond, hooded, upturned, downturned, deep-set) with makeup-application advice tailored to each shape

arabic_text: كوتيه - مساحيق تجميل / جدول قطارات السكك الحديدية المصرية القاهرة-الإسكندرية
translation: Advertising page for "Kwt-y" makeup powders next to the Egyptian State Railways timetable for the Cairo-Alexandria line — departure times, ticket classes and stops arranged in a printed grid

arabic_text: كحه… ولا؟! - عمود ساخر مع كاريكاتير بابا نويل السياسي
translation: "Kohh… Wa'lla?!" (Even Then?!) — political-satire column commenting on the year-end Egyptian scene, illustrated with a cartoon of a Santa Claus figure (Papa Noel) bringing dubious political "gifts" to Middle Eastern statesmen

arabic_text: برلمان في مخيم اللاجئين بالقنطرة - تحقيق مصور عن اللاجئين الفلسطينيين
translation: "Parliament in the Al-Qantara Refugee Camp" — full-page photo essay on Palestinian refugees at the Qantara camp on the Suez Canal: photographs of tents, families receiving aid, and a mock "parliament" the refugees have organized to elect camp representatives

arabic_text: ميرنا لوي - صورة كاملة الصفحة للنجمة الهوليوودية
translation: Full-page glamour portrait of Hollywood star Myrna Loy set against a floral background, with a caption profiling the actress's latest MGM release and famous "Thin Man" film-series role

arabic_text: إعلان أسبرو لعلاج البرد / موت في سكون - تكملة القصة
translation: Aspro cold-remedy full-page advertisement ("Take Aspro at the first sign of a cold") beside the concluding installment of the dramatic short story "Death in Silence"

arabic_text: الشيخ أبو العيون - تكملة / إعلان كوكاكولا كامل الصفحة - لذيذة ومنعشة
translation: Continuation of the article/interview "Sheikh Abou Al-Ayoon" (portrait of a colorful traditional-scholar personality) alongside a full-page Coca-Cola advertisement — "Delicious and Refreshing" — with the iconic bottle graphic

arabic_text: أنحن الجنس اللطيف؟! - مقال هزلي مع كاريكاتير رجل نحيل وامرأة بدينة / قصة لوسي لاييني
translation: "Are We the Gentle Sex?!" — humorous women's-column essay illustrated with a cartoon contrasting a scrawny man with an imposing plump wife, next to the story "Loo-si Layi'ni" — a comic tale of romantic mismatch

arabic_text: إعلان شركة شمال أفريقيا التجارية - نيت (NEAT) - سيارات ويليز أوفرلاند الجديدة / كواكب - فراسات مخالط شربر عن فاطمة رشدي
translation: Full-page advertisement for the North Africa Commercial Company (Sharikat Shamal Afriqiya Al-Tijariyya) — Willys Overland cars, with the NEAT logo showing the African continent map with compass; next to "Al-Kawakib" (The Stars) column — palmistry-style personality reading for actress Fatma Rushdi ("one of the most famous stars born")

arabic_text: أبله بوجه وشلع أفندي - عمود عن الطلاب والمعلمين / صابون روضة (زيت الزيتون الخالص) - وإعلان ملح فواكه إينوس
translation: "Ibla Bwjih wa Shala Effendi" — humor essay about the peculiar antics of certain schoolteachers and the pranks students play on them, illustrated with cartoon of a bemused mustachioed effendi in tarbouche and a plump, veiled schoolgirl-figure; alongside Rawda soap ad ("pure olive-oil soap") and Melh Fawakih Enos (Eno's Fruit Salt) advertisement

arabic_text: بيسي دبيسي عبود باشا! - بقلم محمد فرغلي باشا / إعلان صابون الحدوة - وإعلان بكري (مؤسسة سنة 1884)
translation: "Beisi Debbaisi Abboud Basha!" — full-page essay by Muhammad Farghali Basha reminiscing about the tycoon Ahmad Abboud Basha with wry anecdotes about his business habits, illustrated with cartoon of a couple shopping; alongside Al-Hidwah (Horseshoe brand) cooperative-society soap ad and Bakri publishers ad (est. 1884)

arabic_text: عيادة السعادة… بقلم طبيب السعادة - عمود نصائح يومية / فيلم فتنة مع كاميليا - يحيى شاهين
translation: "Ayadat Al-Sa'ada" (Clinic of Happiness) daily-life advice column by "The Doctor of Happiness" — divided into two brief essays: "A Minute for Your Health" and "A Minute for Your Work"; alongside advertisement for the film "Fitna" starring Kamelia and Yehia Chahine (with the actor's headshot inset)

arabic_text: بعث أمتنا - مقال سياسي - مع رسم لتمثال الحرية باكياً وترومان
translation: "Ba'ath Ummatna" (The Resurrection of Our Nation) — patriotic political essay on Egypt's post-war awakening, illustrated with a striking cartoon of the Statue of Liberty in tears leaning against a pillar while an Uncle Sam / Truman-type figure gestures below with a top-hat — caption reads "[Truman's grip on the fate of the small nations is such that he no longer offers freedom but only Marshall aid…]"

arabic_text: أعظم 6 قصص غرام هوليودية - غلاف مع صورة نجمين
translation: Full-page feature-cover "The 6 Greatest Hollywood Love Stories" with a large color double-portrait of a matinee-idol couple (Errol Flynn-style leading man and a smiling white-headscarfed leading lady) inside a big red heart shape; intro caption promises six star-couple stories culminating in "Love ended in marriage for every one of them"

arabic_text: مسابقة - أحسن نكتة لهذا الرسم! - كاريكاتير امرأة تصوّب مسدساً على رجل بطربوش
translation: "Contest — The Best Joke for This Drawing!" — reader caption-writing competition: full-panel cartoon of a fierce woman pointing a pistol at a fleeing tarbouche-wearing effendi; contest rules and prize list (one Egyptian pound and other small cash prizes, entries due 19 April 1948) printed below

arabic_text: أوقفني الترام - قصة / إعلان الدراسات العالية بمتناول يدك - المدارس الدولية بالمراسلة / صابون نيوترون
translation: "Awqifni Al-Ziram" (Stop the Tram) — humorous short-story continuation on chaotic public-transit anecdotes; International Correspondence Schools (Cairo branch) advertisement — "Higher Studies Within Your Reach" listing engineering, accounting and business courses; Nitroun soap ad ("38 years serving Egypt") and silhouette drawing of a boy and girl greeting

arabic_text: صورة كاملة الصفحة ملونة لقائد عسكري مصري كبير جالساً على مكتبه
translation: Full-page color portrait of an Egyptian army general (likely a senior figure in the Palestine War command) in dress uniform seated at his ornate office desk, holding a cigar; framed Quranic-inscription plaque hangs above him on the wall

arabic_text: بنت ذوات - قصة قصيرة / إعلان ديتول المعقم - إعلان بونومنت - إعلان روبيرت ريتا
translation: "Bint Zawat" (Daughter of the Elite) — short story about a rich young woman's romantic dilemma; column flanked by ads for Dettol antiseptic (bottle graphic), Bonomint (mint sweet) and Robert Rieti (Roberto Rita) glamorous mannequin fashion

arabic_text: كلام وحريّت - عمود ساخر ونمائم فنية - مع رسم كاريكاتير سيدتين تحتسيان الشاي
translation: "Kalam Wa Hurriyat" (Talk and Freedoms) — society-gossip humor column with vignettes on marriage-market intrigues, an army-officer flirt "Mandoub Al-Ithnayn" and news from café society; illustrated with a cartoon of two glamorous ladies chatting over cocktails at a café table

arabic_text: أنا هولاء… - مقال / إعلان شفرات جيليت الزرقاء - إعلان معجون كولينوس
translation: "Ana Hollywood…" (I Am Hollywood…) — literary column continuation; alongside a Gillette blue-blade advertisement ("choose the Gillette with three-layer edges — five layers for only 5 piastres") and a Kolynos Dental Cream ad with a smiling starlet — "because it has magical foam"

arabic_text: اطلبوا مفارم اللحوم بولندرز (إيديال) - إعلان كبير / مقال عن أعياد الأطفال والشجرة وسيام
translation: "Order Bolinders (Ideal) meat mincers" — full-page advertisement for the Swedish-made Bolinders "Ideal" hand-cranked meat grinders (two size illustrations); alongside a feature on children's Christmas trees, holiday customs in Siam (Thailand) and Egypt's own emerging children's-holiday movement

arabic_text: لا أناه! - في قسم البوليس - قصة سيدة أحضرت مولوداً / إعلان محمد علي موبيليات مودرن - إعلان صبغة كامبريدج - إعلان صرفيل الياسمين
translation: "La Anaah!" (Oh No Him!) — women's-column story of a lady in the police station reporting a strange complaint about a foundling baby; alongside advertisements for Muhammad Ali "Mobiliyat Modern" (Modern Furniture Fair, est. 1346 AH) and Sir Byl El-Yasmin (jasmine-perfumed products) and Cambridge hair-dye ("removes grey without residue")

arabic_text: طبائع بنات حواء! - صورة كاملة الصفحة للنجمة إليانور باركر مع توقيعها
translation: "Nature of the Daughters of Eve!" — full-page color portrait of Hollywood star Eleanor Parker in a white blouse with a red-flower background, with her autograph "For Al-Itnayn — Sincerely, Eleanor Parker" reproduced across the bottom; short caption profiles the "Winner" star; issue no. 690, September 1, 1947

arabic_text: بمناسبة شهر رمضان المبارك - إعلان شركة مصر للمنتجات الأهلية / إعلان صابون لوريول
translation: Full-page double advertisement: (top) Egyptian National Products Company (Sharikat Misr Lil-Muntajat Al-Ahliya) Ramadan-Kareem greeting to the Muslim community with product-price reductions announcement; (bottom) Lauriol "Le Savon de la Jeunesse" toilet-soap ad with woman's face and "golden youth" slogan

arabic_text: قصة تشابيه أمريكية - انتقام الرئيس ترومان - مع رسم أشباح ترومان في الجنة
translation: "A Bit of American Fantasy — President Truman's Revenge" — satirical short story imagining Truman haunted by the ghosts of Hiroshima victims; illustrated with a pen-and-ink drawing of turbaned figures pointing to Truman in a starry heaven with the caption "[These are the ones haunting Truman — the victims of the atom bomb in the celestial court]"

arabic_text: الزهور الحزينة - فيلم جديد - فاتن حمامة، حسين رياض، عبد الرحمن الرافعي - إعلان استوديو مصر
translation: Full-page advertisement for the new Egyptian film "Al-Zhoor Al-Hazina" (The Sad Flowers) — starring Faten Hamama, Hussein Riyad, Zeinab Sedky, Serag Munir; production and distribution by Studio Misr; poster shows Faten Hamama in the sickbed scene, plus below-listed article previews from Al-Hilal magazine (September 1952) including "An Iraqi Message to the Youth," "Great Feast — For Truth?" and "They Were Kings… They Left Their Thrones"

arabic_text: الحق قبل الحرب - مقال سياسي - مع كاريكاتير هيئة الأمم المتحدة تُقاد بواسطة الرأسمالية
translation: "Al-Haqq Qabl Al-Harb" (Truth Before War) — political essay arguing that Arabs must invoke international law before conflict; illustrated with a bitter cartoon of a hooded UN General Assembly figure being manhandled and dragged by a group of top-hatted capitalist figures — caption reads "[Truth was dragged and defended by force and killed — what came out of it? Truth still perishes under the boots of oppressors]"

arabic_text: المختار وأخواته - عدد سبتمبر 1947 - إعلان مجلة المختار
translation: Full-page advertisement for the Arabic Reader's Digest "Al-Mukhtar" (September 1947 issue) listing its featured articles: "Human Life" (translated biography of Lin Yutang), "I Was Married to Rimsky-Korsakov" (Russian composer's wife's memoir), "Aspirin — Is It Sugar?," "Ancient Cures That Modern Medicine Ignored" and more — 144 pages for 3 piastres

arabic_text: هوليوود البلد مصر - بقلم الأستاذ حسين فوزي - أخبار الفن والسينما - عواصف، بوم في العالي، نجاح الفرقة المصرية، من باريس إلى مصر
translation: "Hollywood — the Country Is Egypt!" — arts-and-cinema news column by Prof. Hussein Fawzy: items on new Egyptian films ("Awasef"/Storms with Fatima Rushdy and Firouz Halawa; "Boom Fi Al-Aali"/Boom on High), success of the Egyptian theatre troupe abroad, and "From Paris to Egypt" — return of Yousef Wahby to Studio Misr, plus headshots of the featured actors

arabic_text: اضحك مع ثرى الحرب! - رسوم كاريكاتير عن مخيال الحرب - فتاة بدينة تشد بلي الرافعة، أطباء يقتلعون البلطجية، عامل يقتات على المصنع
translation: "Laugh with the War Profiteer!" — full-page satirical cartoon panel: (top) a plump war-profiteer's wife knocking down her thin housemaid with the caption "The war-profiteer's wife tumbles the maid — how much did she pocket?"; (middle) doctors as fishermen extracting a big-fish patient; (bottom) an industrialist inflating war-industry balloons over the corpses of workers

arabic_text: كشكول أمريكاني! - جنون الموضة - مندوب "الاثنين" الخاص - أزياء نيويورك من الأحذية للعمامة
translation: "American Sketchbook!" — "Fashion Madness" — dispatch from New York by Al-Itnayn's American correspondent on the season's post-war fashion craze: a spectacular studded high-heel shoe photographed alongside two mannequin shots — a peplum-blouse ensemble and an actress in a folded-newspaper-style turban headdress

arabic_text: هنا محطة رأس البر! - مذكرات صديق قضى شهر عسله في المصيف / إعلان راديو لوكس / بودرة توكالون - فاسينا سبير
translation: "Here Is Ras Al-Barr Station!" — a humor essay recounting a friend's honeymoon at the Ras Al-Barr Nile-mouth resort, illustrated with a cartoon of a scowling honeymoon-couple in confusion at a hotel; alongside Lux Radios ("Second Broadcaster Now Available") ad and Toucalon face-powder ad with photo of "Faten Sinh"

arabic_text: خواطر - معرض جانبي على شواطئ البحر - صورة كاملة الصفحة لفتاة على الصخور بالبحر
translation: "Khawatir" (Thoughts) — reflective essay on summer resort culture ("Body-shapes exhibition on the beach") lamenting the loss of dignity in the modern seaside; illustrated with a large full-page photograph of a young woman in a white two-piece swimsuit and headband, seated barefoot on the rocks by the sea with her carrier-bag beside her

arabic_text: الإنسان يقلد الطبيعة - أم أن الطبيعة تقلده؟! - مقارنات مصورة
translation: "Does Man Imitate Nature — or Does Nature Imitate Man?!" — full-page photo-essay pairing look-alike images: a South American bird's plumage vs. a North American woman's feathered hat; an elephant's wrinkled hide vs. an old man's grooved face; a gorilla-figure vs. a bodybuilder posing on stage — asking whether art copies nature or nature copies art

arabic_text: إعلان أسبيرول - ضد الزكام والصداع والإنفلوانزا / إعلان فيلم ريغولى - القوس السحري - جيمس كنت، ستوارت جرانجر
translation: Advertising page: (top) Aspirol tablets — for colds, headache, flu, rheumatism (with coin-and-tablet graphic); (below) full-page ad for the film "Rigolli" and "The Magic Bow" (Al-Qows Al-Sahri) starring Stewart Granger and Jean Kent — with the caption "Second week with great success" and Cairo cinema-showing details; alongside inset photo of a tribally-dressed dancing figure

arabic_text: الأزياء الجسمية المبتكرة خصيصاً للتفصيل الحبيب - الصالون الأخضر / إعلان قطرة برونتكس - العيون جواهر ثمينة
translation: "Custom-Made Innovative Body Fashions for the Beloved's Measurements" — full-page advertisement for Al-Salon Al-Akhdar (The Green Salon) dressmaking house in Cairo and Alexandria (elegant sketch of a beribboned dress); alongside Bronticiks eye-drops ad — "Eyes are precious jewels" — with a beauty portrait; short-story continuation column

arabic_text: فلاحة تقود شعباً! - إنجريد برجمان - جان دارك على الشاشة البيضاء
translation: "A Peasant Girl Leads a People!" — full-page color still of Ingrid Bergman as Joan of Arc in silver armor and chain-mail hood holding a sword, with an inset smiling portrait in a white peasant's kerchief; caption promotes Victor Fleming's 1948 film "Joan of Arc"

arabic_text: إعلان فيلم الستار الحديدي - يوسف وهبي / إعلان أفلام من غيرنا - كاميرا سينما / إعلان الغزالة / إعلان نسيم بورخية
translation: Advertising page: film advertisement for "Al-Sitar Al-Hadidi" (The Iron Curtain) starring Yousef Wahby (poster with actor's headshots); Camera cinemas ad — "Aflam Min Ghirna" (Films from Beyond); Al-Ghazala shop ad; Nasim Bourkhia ad

arabic_text: إعلان بي أو إيه سي - الطيران البريطاني حول العالم - 640 طيار / إعلان صبغة كلمانز الزرقاء / إعلان سلفاكرين / العدسة الحادقة - مسابقة مصورة
translation: Advertising page + puzzle: BOAC (British Overseas Airways Corporation) full-page ad — network of 640 pilots covering 100 million miles a year, world-map illustration with silhouettes of countries served (Britain, Middle East, Egypt, Iran, India, Pakistan, Ceylon, South Africa, Australia, New Zealand, etc.); alongside Colman's Mustard/Blue ad and Sulfa-Karin cosmetic-medical ad; column "Al-Adasa Al-Haddaqa" (The Sharp Lens) — 8-image spot-the-object photo puzzle

arabic_text: بعض محتويات هلال أكتوبر الطلبة - إعلان محتويات العدد الجديد من مجلة الهلال
translation: Full-page advertisement listing the contents of the October student-issue of Al-Hilal magazine: memoirs of the freedom fight in Sinai, biography of Doctor Haykal Basha, historical article, adventurous story, articles on painting and photography, women's-column and other features — 200 pages plus a free color-picture-page insert, all for 6 piastres

arabic_text: ساسة مصر على المشرحة - بقلم عبد الحميد عبد الحق - نقد سياسيين ومحلليين مصريين
translation: "Egypt's Politicians on the Autopsy Table" — full-page satirical political-analysis feature by Abdul-Hamid Abdul-Haq dissecting the personalities of leading figures: Mustafa Al-Nahhas, Ismail Sidqi, Ali Maher, Ibrahim Abd al-Hadi, Abdul-Majid Ibrahim, Fouad Serag Al-Din, Hafez Afifi, Makram Ebeid, Hafez Ramadan and Mahmoud Al-Nokrashy — with each caricatured head-portrait as a caption for the writer's diagnosis of their political ills

arabic_text: بديل عام 1948 - إعلان الأزياء الأنيقة / إعلان مصنوعات الجمل - بقشرة ذهبية مضمونة خمس سنوات / إعلان تصريحات كولوت إلى الخارج - قنوى وخطيب
translation: Advertising page: full-page annual-fashion "Cost of 1948 Life" ad for a Cairo dressmaker's opening for the 1948 season; "Masnou'at Al-Jamal" (Camel-brand crafted goods) — five-year guaranteed golden-plated wares (Fahmy, Rezk & Co.); "Tasarih Kulaht Ila Al-Kharij" (Overseas Travel Permits) — Faroudi & Khatib menu-house at Adly Basha St. Cairo, illustrated with animals in cages

arabic_text: شخصيات لبستهم! - فنانو المسرح المصري في أدوارهم - ماري منيب، عبد الفتاح المصري، سيد سليمان
translation: "Personalities That Suit Them!" — photo-feature on great Egyptian stage actors in their signature roles: Mary Munib in the role of a mother-in-law/rich lady; Abdul-Fattah Al-Masri in the role of Galail Abu Shaadouf (peasant garb, hand-raised); and Sayed Sleiman as Am Abu Shadouf (in country costume) — arguing that only these performers can bring these characters to life

arabic_text: الرسم "موضة" في أمريكا / الحب… والكره - بقلم الدكتور إبراهيم ناجي / إعلان شفرات O-K / إعلان براسو لتلميع المعادن
translation: "Drawing Is a Fashion in America" — feature on the American amateur-painting craze; alongside a philosophical essay "Al-Hobb… Wal-Karah" (Love… and Hate) by the poet-doctor Ibrahim Nagi; ads for O-K razor blades ("the safe blade") and Brasso metal polish ("for gleaming brasswork")

arabic_text: فيضان النيل يزيد مضايقات الصيف - إعلان أسبرو مع رسم الأهرامات / رسم مسجون
translation: "The Nile Flood Increases Summer Troubles" — Aspro (Aspro) full-page ad tying its cold-and-headache remedy to the miseries of the annual Nile flood season, illustrated with the pyramids/desert design; alongside a small cartoon of a Bedouin/prisoner squatting at a jailhouse window

arabic_text: بريد القلوب - عمود نصائح للقارئات / إعلان بوندز - لم يقع اختيار الكثيرات من فتيات اليوم / إعلان سجائر إكسترافين
translation: "Bareed Al-Quloob" (Mail of the Hearts) — reader-letters advice column for young ladies on love and marriage; Pond's Cold Cream ad ("Many of today's girls have not chosen a single moisturizer!") with an illustrated beauty applying cream at her dressing-table; Extrafine cigarettes ad — "The pride of Egyptian tobaccos"

arabic_text: إعلان ماكياج ماكس فاكتور هوليوود / سؤال وجواب مع القراء / إعلان طبعة البوليس والحرية - مرزوق
translation: Full-page Max Factor Hollywood makeup advertisement — Egyptian-actress endorser's photo, promises of eleven Hollywood-color shades and a free sample coupon; alongside a Q&A advice column with readers about lipstick, mascara and hair; Marzouq "Police & Freedom Books" publisher's ad

arabic_text: غلاف مجلة الاثنين والدنيا - صورة ملونة كبيرة لممثلة بشعر مموج وشفاه حمراء
translation: Front cover of Al-Itnayn wal-Dunia magazine: worn/water-damaged full-page color portrait of a Hollywood-style leading lady with wavy platinum-and-honey hair, red lipstick and a pearl choker against a rich crimson-brown background

arabic_text: الفلاسفة في مرتبة الخدم! - أزمة الخدم في مصر - مقال تاريخي / إعلان مجوهرات عكاوى / إعلان مدرسة الرقي للأزياء والسينما
translation: "Philosophers in the Rank of Servants!" — feature on Egypt's servant-shortage crisis, drawing a historical parallel with ancient Rome (where slaves included philosophers); alongside Akkawi jewelry-and-watches ad with elegant portrait of a Faten Hamama-style beauty in pearls, and a school-of-cinema-and-fashion training-course advertisement

arabic_text: السياسي المعتزل يعترف! - سؤال وجواب مع مواطن على المعاش سياسي / إعلان كولونيا روس / إعلان علامة روزريز
translation: "The Retired Politician Confesses!" — mock question-and-answer column putting satirical political questions to a former minister; illustrated with a red-carpet border of comic figures; alongside a Rose Cologne ad ("la Delicate Perfumée") featuring a beauty-portrait with roses, and a "Farabik Zerzer" (a stylish sports-cologne) ad — Finito Sfouf 10 July 1948

arabic_text: ملاهي الإسكندرية بالإزاريطة / إعلان فيلم عذراء الريف / ضحك… وبكاء! - عمود نكات
translation: "Alexandria Amusements at Al-Azarita" — feature on Al-Kursaal beach club's summer programme (contest prizes, evening entertainments); alongside advertising for the film "'Azraa' Al-Reef" (Village Virgin) starring Fatma Rushdy; "Dahk… Wa Bika!" (Laughter and Tears!) — daily-joke column with numbered witty vignettes on marriage, mother-in-law and honeymoon-mishaps

arabic_text: قافلة عن أبطالنا - تحقيق مصور عن المصريات اللاتي يخدمن الجيش على جبهة فلسطين
translation: "Fi Kafla Wan Abtalna" (In a Caravan for Our Heroes!) — photo essay on Egyptian women's volunteer war-effort work behind the Palestine front: photos of ladies assembling and packing supplies, sewing garments and writing letters to soldiers, with two smiling profile portraits at a desk labeled with their names

arabic_text: إعلان طيران TWA - أوروبا وأمريكا وإيطاليا وفرنسا / إعلان معجون كولينوس - نظف أسنانك - لأن له رغوة سخية
translation: Advertising page: TWA (Trans World Airlines) ad promoting weekly flights to Europe/Italy/France (11 trips a week to America, 10 to Italy, 8 to France) — with the winged "TWA" logo; alongside a Kolynos Dental Cream advertisement — "Clean your teeth with Kolynos… because it has a generous foam!" with a cartoon of a smiling Egyptian young man in tarbouche

arabic_text: الأمير رمضان يقول - رسم كبير للأمير - قصص العيد - الطبيب المجهول، فرحتان! - مع صور ثلاث فنانات
translation: "The Prince Ramadan Says!" — full-page Ramadan-themed decoration featuring a bold woodcut-style figure of a bearded prince in traditional dress with a coffee-tray captioned "The Feast Is My Gift to You — and I Gave the King Farouk a Gift for Your Eyes"; on the right, three short stories from Egyptian actresses' Ramadan memories — "The Unknown Doctor" (Fatima Rushdy), "Two Happy Moments" (Magda Ismail), "For the Wonders" (a third actress) — each with a small color/red-tinted headshot

arabic_text: من يوميّات طفل رضيع - بقلم الأستاذ وليم أسيلى - مع رسم كاريكاتيري لطفل يدخن ويكتب
translation: "From the Diary of a Nursing Baby" — humorous first-person essay by William Asyl imagining a Cairo baby's daily thoughts, illustrated with a wild cartoon of a knowing infant smoking a pipe at a desk surrounded by more baby-scenes: crying, being fed, being dressed by grandma and confronted with rival toddlers

arabic_text: القاتل يرث القتيل! - نقد قرار تقسيم فلسطين - مع كاريكاتير "العالم يعزف نهاية العود"
translation: "The Killer Inherits the Killed!" — bitter political-legal essay condemning the UN partition of Palestine as "the murderer inheriting the victim"; illustrated with a striking cartoon captioned "[The world plays the finale — of Napoleon and Moore!!]" showing top-hatted Uncle Sam figures whispering into the ear of a blonde-haired female Truman-piano-player facing a machine-gun-toting soldier at the door

arabic_text: عيادة السعادة! - نصائح يومية لصحتك، لعملك، لنفسك، لبيتك / إعلان فيلم الحب لا يموت - عذراء الوداع
translation: "Ayadat Al-Sa'ada" (Clinic of Happiness) — four-minute daily advice column: A Minute for Your Health, A Minute for Your Work, Confidence in Yourself, and Food & Nutrition; alongside a poster ad for the film "Al-Hobb La Yamoot" (Love Does Not Die) — "'Azraa' Al-Wadaa'" (Virgin of the Farewell) with headshots of Serag Munir, Rafia Ibrahim, Abbas Fares and the cast

arabic_text: بريد القلوب - عمود قارئات / إعلان مدرسة بينيت البريطانية بالمراسلة - Bennett College Sheffield / إعلان مدرسة الأشكلاريا
translation: "Bareed Al-Quloob" advice column (letters from Fifa Al-Ahli, Kfar Al-Aisha, Umm Duraman etc. on romance and marriage); Bennett College Sheffield full-page correspondence-course ad ("Learn to Earn — 220 disciplines from Accountancy to Wireless Telegraphy" — Cairo Emad El-Dine Street branch); and Al-Ashkilariya photography-and-radio institute ad

arabic_text: القاهرة… في أمريكا! - رحلة إلى مدينة تسمى كايرو - كنيسة الكايرو المعمدانية، أخوان خوري، شاطئ نهر الميسيسيبي، فندق كايرو / إعلان مفصلات DTC / إعلان بينيت / إعلان يتام
translation: "Cairo… in America!" — travel feature on the small city of Cairo, Illinois ("Cayrou") at the Ohio-Mississippi confluence, illustrated with four photographs: the Cairo Baptist Church, a Mississippi paddle-boat by "Cairo Bay" pier, the Khoury Brothers ready-to-wear store, and the city's Cairo Hotel — the town's US history since 1861 and Civil War role; sidebar ads for DTC Cairo hinges, Bennett College and Yateim men's underwear

arabic_text: الألغام الممنون - تكملة قصة حرب / رسم بالألوان لأم وطفلها الرضيع - غير مرحب به
translation: Continuation of the war-memoir story "Al-Alghaam Al-Mamnoon" (The Grateful Mines) about a soldier who survived a minefield thanks to a fortunate misstep; illustrated with a large full-color pathos painting of a Madonna-like mother clutching a naked baby, captioned "[The unwelcome child…]"

arabic_text: البنون زينة الحياة الدنيا - مسرحية اجتماعية بقلم عبد الله المشوق - مع رسم زوجين يتضاحكان / إعلان عطر هيرست / إعلان ملح أندروز
translation: "Al-Banoon Zaynat Al-Hayat Al-Dunya" (Sons — the Adornment of This Worldly Life) — social-comedy stage play by Abdullah Al-Mashuq, illustrated with a spirited pen-and-ink drawing of a laughing couple (the husband cradling his wife in his arms); alongside a Hearst perfume advertising column and an Andrews Liver Salt reminder "For Your Inner Cleanliness"

arabic_text: غلاف العدد 635 - 5 أغسطس 1946 - الترفيه - عدد خاص - "لا يهن على القش" - وجه فتاة على القش
translation: Front cover of issue no. 635 (5 August 1946) "Al-Tarfeeh" (Entertainment) — a special summer-issue: full-page color portrait of a young woman lying on golden straw, her face turned toward the camera with a wide smile; caption reads "Cool on the Straw!"

arabic_text: والدي جلالة الإمام يحيى - بقلم سمو الأمير سيف الإسلام عبد الله - مع رسمين للإمام - أي الصورتين أقرب للمنظر؟
translation: "My Father, His Majesty Imam Yahya" — biographical article on the Yemeni Imam Yahya by Prince Sayf al-Islam Abdullah, on his father's leadership of Yemen and the North Yemen Kingdom during and after WWI, his Quran-first policy and Arab independence stance; illustrated with two artist's line-portraits of the Imam side-by-side, plus a reader contest asking "Which of the two portraits is closer to the real appearance?" with prize incentives

arabic_text: الدنيا مزوظ حظّ! - مقال ساخر - مع رسم كاريكاتير لزوجين في سيارة قديمة
translation: "Life Is Only a Stroke of Luck!" — humorous reflective essay on how fortune, not effort, decides destinies in Egypt's post-war society; illustrated with a large color painting of a bourgeois couple in an old-style open-top sports car being nearly overturned on a curve, giant leaves and city-lights swirling around them

arabic_text: وزارة الدفاع الوطني - السلاح البحري الملكي - قبول طلبة بحريين / كيف يجن البنون في أمريكا؟ - رسم كاريكاتير رقص / إعلان أقراص أسبرو
translation: Official recruitment advertisement — Ministry of National Defense, Royal Naval Force: accepting naval-cadet applications (Alexandria naval-school, October 1947 start, ages 15–22, requirements listed); alongside "How the Youngsters Are Made Crazy in America?!" — cartoon feature on the American dance/jitterbug craze, with a bandstand-crowd cartoon; Aspro tablets ad for headache and cold relief

arabic_text: رفضت القوى الكبرى وقف القتال - الجندي المصري لا يعود! - مع كاريكاتير الجندي المصري يطعن أخطبوط الصهيونية
translation: "The Great Powers Rejected the Truce — the Egyptian Soldier Will Not Return!" — full-page political article and cartoon: a magnificent illustration of an Egyptian soldier in helmet stabbing a bloated multi-tentacled octopus labeled "Al-Sahyoniyya" (Zionism) with his bayonet, with barbed wire in the background — caption expresses defiance at the failed UN cease-fire and the Egyptian army's continued Palestine campaign

arabic_text: ليالي القاهرة - تاريخ الترفيه القاهري / إعلان ديتول المطهر / إعلان فرشة أسنان / إعلان حبوب كارتر
translation: "Layali Al-Qahira" (Nights of Cairo) — historical feature on Cairo's turn-of-the-century entertainment scene: French cabaret at the Franco-Egyptian Theater, the Al-Fontograf recording-parlor, first star of Al-Dorados dance halls; alongside Dettol antiseptic ad, Al-Anwar (light) toothbrushes ad and Carter's Little Pills laxative ad — "Alarm Yayfah… Al-Kaslan Al-Yaom"

arabic_text: ما ألذ الطعام! - إعلان سمن الجمل - إذا كان مصنوعاً بالسمن الهولندي - Camel Brand Syrian Butter Substitute
translation: "Ma Aladh Al-Ta'aam!" (How Delicious the Food!) — full-page ad for Camel Brand Syrian Butter Substitute (Made in Holland), with a comic drawing of two housewives — one furious, the other happy — arguing over a soup pot; slogan promotes the brand's guaranteed quality, purity of manufacture and fair price; distributor Khudr wa Munir Al-Qaisi & Partners (Cairo)

arabic_text: غلاف العدد 736 - 19 يوليو 1948 - ليندا كريستيان - صورة كبيرة للنجمة الهوليوودية
translation: Front cover of issue no. 736 (19 July 1948): color portrait of Hollywood glamour star Linda Christian with long wavy honey-blonde hair, red lips and a pearl necklace over a soft cream blouse against a warm brown background

arabic_text: خادمات اليوم! - كاريكاتير عن الخدم اليوم / إعلان أحمر الشفاه سوار دي باري بورجوا / إعلان أحذية قنطرة / إعلان بروجالنيس
translation: "The Servants of Today!" — full-page comic-strip on the woes of the modern Egyptian mistress-and-maid: (top) master hugs the maid on the sofa while the wife looks in; (middle) the wife scolds; (bottom) the husband storms out — with sneering captions in colloquial Egyptian; alongside Bourgeois "Sourire de Paris" red lipstick ad, Bronticinos-style ad, and Farrage shoes' new-collection ad

arabic_text: انتقام المجنون! - قصة مصرية بقلم الأستاذ إبراهيم الوردانى - مع رسم استجواب بوليس
translation: "Intiqam Al-Majanoon!" (Revenge of the Madman!) — dramatic Egyptian short story by Ibrahim Al-Wardani about a jealous husband's murderous plot, illustrated with a fine pen-and-ink drawing of a plain-clothes detective and uniformed officer aggressively interrogating a suspect at a hat-and-coat rack, kicking a chair aside

arabic_text: غلاف العدد 729 - 31 مايو 1948 - "ياليت" - صورة كبيرة ملونة لسيدة بفستان أبيض من الطراز الفكتوري
translation: Front cover of issue no. 729 (31 May 1948) — "Yalit" (I Wish): full-page color portrait of an Egyptian model/actress in a lavish white ruffled Victorian-style gown with a jewelled ruby-and-gold necklace and matching hair ornament; magazine masthead "Al-Itnayn & Al-Dunia — Cairo Egypt — 31 May 1948 — 22 Rajab 1367"
