arabic_text: نريد بطنة السلطة بالجليد - كاريكاتير الخدم / فرحين ببدء العام الدراسي 1948-1949 - إعلان شركة صنع المصنوعات المصرية / إعلان صبغة الشعب
translation: "We Want the Iced Vegetable-Salad Belly!" — humor cartoon-and-essay about mistress-maid quarrels at the summer table ("the pashas want salad on ice"); alongside a full-page "Happy to Begin the 1948-1949 School Year" advertisement from Sharikat Sani' Al-Masnou'aat Al-Misriya (Egyptian Manufacturing Co.) with cartoon of a smiling boy carrying school-supplies; below, Madaeem hair-dye ad — "Removes grey without residue"

arabic_text: غلاف العدد 726 - 12 يوليو 1948 - سابين هاسو - صورة كبيرة ملونة للممثلة بفستان لماع
translation: Front cover of issue no. 726 (12 July 1948) — full-page color portrait of Hollywood/European actress "Sabine Hasse" (Sabinah Hasso) in a shimmering aqua-blue high-neck sequined gown against an ornate cream Moorish filigree screen; caption directs readers to page 87 for her feature

arabic_text: إعلان ملح فواكه إينوس - كلما اشتدت عليك وطأة الحر / إعلان معجون أسنان تشيبس - أسنان قوية ناصعة البياض S.R.
translation: Advertising page: Enos Fruit Salt "Melh Fawakih Enos" — "Whenever summer heat weighs on you, a fizzy sparkling glass of Fruit Salt refreshes and revives you" — with rooster-and-bottle graphic; Chibs (Chibbs) dental cream "For Strong Teeth of Dazzling White" — with photos of two glamorous smiles applying the paste

arabic_text: وداع الكوليرا… - قصيدة عن نهاية وباء الكوليرا / إعلان كأس من أوتار / إعلان أسبيرول / رسم رجل يفر من الحريق
translation: "Farewell to Cholera!" — celebratory Arabic poem/verses on the passing of the 1947 cholera epidemic (the pillars and mosques rejoice, the cholera departs); alongside "A Glass of Autard" (musical-strings glass, a spirit drink) ad; Aspirol tablets ad; and a small color cartoon of a bald cook running from a house fire — captioned "Domestic Troubles!"

arabic_text: مهاجرين عرب وفرنسيين - تحقيق مصور من فلسطين - ثلاث صور - مجاهدون في القدس، سيارة مصفحة، الحي اليهودي
translation: "Muhaajereen 'Arab wa Faransyoon" (Arab and French Immigrants!) — three-photo essay from the Palestine front: (top) three Arab-army machine-gunners crouching behind a felled tree in a Jerusalem street firing at Jewish neighborhoods; (middle) Egyptian volunteer fighters gathered around a captured Zionist armored car with an Egyptian flag planted on it; (bottom) panoramic view of the Old City of Jerusalem with an arrow marking "The Jewish Quarter"

arabic_text: اسمها على غير مسمى! - أسماء فنية جميلة على غير مسمى - أنا غنى (زكى طليمات)، أنا شيطانية (ملك)، أنا ناقص (كمال المصرى)
translation: "Called by an Unfitting Name!" — full-page satirical portrait-set of three Egyptian art personalities in caricatures that contradict their names: on the left "I Am Faulty!" (maestro Kamal El-Masri drawn in tuxedo with sagging shoulders); center "I Am Devilish!" (starlet Malak drawn as a horned red-devil with pitchfork); right "I Am Singing!" (maestro Zaki Tulaymat drawn as a hopping bald conductor)

arabic_text: معركة بالمسمسم - قصة قصيرة عن قائد يخدع ضابطاً يابانياً / إعلان صابون نابلسي النمر / تمتع بحياة البحار - واخدم وطنك - مدرسة الملاحة الحربية
translation: "Ma'raka Bel-Masasim!" (A Battle by Toothpicks!) — short story of a British/Egyptian commander winning a duel of wits over a Japanese officer with a glass of wine; alongside Nablus Tiger Soap ad and a naval-recruitment poster for the Royal Egyptian Naval College — "Enjoy the Life of the Sea and Serve Your Homeland" (with battleship illustration)

arabic_text: غلاف العدد 747 - 4 أكتوبر 1948 - يا شارد الفكر - صورة كبيرة ملونة لسيدة شقراء
translation: Front cover of issue no. 747 (4 October 1948) — "Ya Sharid Al-Fikr!" (Oh Wanderer of Thought!): full-page color profile portrait of a soft-focus blonde with wavy auburn-lit hair and lowered eyelashes against a deep bottle-green background

arabic_text: تأمين ضد الحب! - قصة قصيرة أمريكية - مع رسم رجل يقع من الكنبة
translation: "Ta'meen Did Al-Hobb!" (Insurance Against Love!) — American short-story translation about a man taking out an eccentric love-insurance policy; illustrated with a wild pen-and-ink drawing of an office worker tumbling head-over-heels off a sofa in front of a laughing couple

arabic_text: إعلان معجون تشيبس S.R - أسنان قوية سليمة / وزارة الدفاع الوطني - رئاسة القوات المرابطة - إعلان مواعيد التقديم
translation: Full-page ad for Chibs (S.R.) toothpaste — "Strong Whole Teeth, Dazzling White Gums" — with two large photos of smiling starlets applying the paste; below, the Egyptian Ministry of National Defence — Royal Coastal Command notice: dates for tenders for naval-college applications and requirement details

arabic_text: فن فن… وإش إش على البلاج! - أطفال بحر - أحفاد الأستاذ محمد عبد الوهاب / إعلان إطارات أرمسترونج / إعلان صبغة كولمانز الزرقاء / إعلان شفرات روبي
translation: "Fen Fen… Wa Ish Ish 'Ala Al-Bilaj!" (Ohh Ahh — What's On the Beach!) — cute children's photo essay: four photos of the grandchildren of maestro Muhammad Abdul-Wahab enjoying their summer at the Alexandria beach: little Kikou and Nadi playing on the sand, drinking pop and rolling on a lounger; alongside Armstrong Tires "Heatmaster de Luxe" ad, Colman's Blue starch, and Rubie razors

arabic_text: في المرآة… - تحقيق مصور عن الرجال في صالونات الحلاقة والتزين
translation: "Fi Al-Mirah…" (In the Mirror…) — full-page candid photo-essay on Egyptian men grooming at Cairo barbershops: six stills of clients being shampooed, having their hair styled, being shaved and treated for dandruff — asking whether man too is enslaved to appearance and mirror

arabic_text: المشي… فن! - كيف تمشي المرأة أمامك بأناقة - أربع صور نمطية / إعلان صابون نابلسي النمر / إعلان جرارات ماتيا بوليس مولين GTA / إعلان إدارة البلديات
translation: "Al-Mashi… Fen!" (Walking is an Art!) — full-page fashion instruction feature with four photos of a slender model demonstrating four styles of graceful walk with a leashed dog; alongside Nabulsi Tiger soap ad and an ad for the sole distributor "G.T.A." of "Matya Bolisen Moulen" tractors, and a Municipalities Administration notice about supply-contract deadlines

arabic_text: غلاف "الاثنين" - محتويات - بلوندز في السجون، مستحيل، الخط الأعمى، آراء البلطان
translation: Contents cover of "Al-Itnayn" magazine: previews of feature stories "Boloroon Fi Al-Sujoun!" (Blondes in Jails), "Mustaheel!" (Impossible!), "Al-Khatt Al-A'ma" (Blind Fate), and "Ara' Al-Boltaanaan" (Views of the Sultans) reader-quiz — with small headshots of the featured actresses and writers

arabic_text: المرأة في حياتك! - بقلم الأستاذ نجيب الريحاني / إعلان كوري لآلام السن والصداع / إعلان شفرات جيليت / حذاء مجاناً
translation: "Al-Mar'a Fi Hayatak!" (Woman in Your Life!) — reflective essay by the famous stage-comedian Naguib Al-Rihani, illustrated with a fantasy drawing of a knight and a female muse; alongside a Koori pain-relief tablets ad (with beauty-portrait), Gillette blades ad, and a "Free Shoes" prize offer

arabic_text: ليس للظمأ موسم! - إعلان كوكاكولا كامل الصفحة / قصة رمال البادية / إعلان بونيمنت
translation: "There Is No Season for Thirst!" — full-page Coca-Cola advertisement showing an iced-bottle-in-basket set-piece ("Drink Coca-Cola — the taste of the season"); alongside a Bedouin-desert short story illustrated with a Bedouin encounter drawing, and a Bonymint (Bono-mint mints) ad

arabic_text: إعلان قلم الحبر مانتمور 46 - Mentmore / مقال حديث دبلوماسي مصري بريطاني / إعلان لوريول - صابون الشباب
translation: Full-page ad for Mentmore 46 fountain pen — the innovator's black-body pen with 14-carat gold nib (silver-cap 195 pt / gold-cap 428 pt); illustrated with pen graphic. Alongside a diplomatic-conversation feature between an Egyptian prime minister and a British ambassador on the Palestine/UN question, and a Lauriol "Youth Soap" ad

arabic_text: حقائق عن… سينما ريفولى - أفخم دور السينما الجديدة في العالم / إعلان ماكياج ويستمور هوليوود / إعلان قطرة برونتكسنن
translation: "Facts About… Cinema Rivoli!" — feature on the newly-opened luxurious Rivoli Cinema in downtown Cairo — one of the world's most modern movie palaces, built in 145 days by an Egyptian firm at a cost of 400,000 pounds, with 1450 seats and all-latest projection equipment; photo of the exterior at night. Alongside Westmore Hollywood makeup ad and Bronticinos eye-drops ad

arabic_text: شيرلي نبيلة! - تحقيق مصور عن الممثلة شيرلي تمبل بعد النضج / إعلان ماء كولونيا كوين اليزابيث / إعلان ساعات جيني
translation: "Shirley Nabila!" — photo-feature on Hollywood child-star Shirley Temple now grown up: stills of her with husband (John Agar) and a smaller-inset shot of her tending flowers at home; caption profiles her new-mature life; alongside Queen Elizabeth cologne ad and Genie luxury-watches advertisement

arabic_text: ضريبة الدم! - قصة مصرية عن أسرة شهيد / تعرف مهرها! - قصة قصيرة / إعلان كتب للجميع - فخروش / إعلان صابون ورد النيل المعطر
translation: "Dhariba Al-Damm!" (The Blood-Tax!) — dramatic Egyptian short story on a family shattered by the loss of a son to war; alongside "Ta'rif Mahraha!" (She Knows Her Bride-Price!) short story column; "Books for Everyone" (Fahrouth publishing house, Bulaq Cairo) — quality books at economical prices; and Ward Al-Nil (Nile-Rose) perfumed soap ad — "Cheap and Good"

arabic_text: صور من الاستوديو - نجمة مصرية في وضع تصوير في صدفة كبيرة زهرية - رجال يعملون معها الماكياج والمجوهرات
translation: Full-page glamour photo of an Egyptian film-actress reclining bare-shouldered inside a giant pink oyster-shell prop being fussed over by two male stylists (makeup artist adjusting her lipstick, jewelry supervisor placing a bracelet); caption discusses the make-up-and-jewelry crew's role in creating a movie-star look, referring to 43 stylists servicing 86 leading ladies

arabic_text: سارق الولاية! - قصة تاريخية عن سرقة سياسية في أمريكا / إعلان الأجهزة الكهربائية الكيرا / إعلان صابون سوبكس
translation: "Sariq Al-Wilaya!" (Thief of the Governorship!) — American historical story about a political-fraud election in 19th-century US (Baron Manoyorko affair of 1848); alongside El-KIRA (Egyptian Electrical Fittings Co.) home-appliances full-page ad — irons, toasters, small appliances — and Sopex laundry-soap advertisement with cartoon of a smiling lady

arabic_text: إعلان صابون روضة - مصنوع من زيت الزيتون النقي / تكملة يا شارد الفكر - عمود جمال
translation: Advertising page: full-page Rawda soap advertisement — "Made of pure olive oil, 8 milliem per bar" — with a captivating drawing of a bare-shouldered lady in a bath tub reaching for a Rawda soap-cube while a spray of olives dangles above; alongside continuation of the beauty-column "Ya Sharid Al-Fikr…"

arabic_text: بيت من الجوع! - قصة قصيرة / إعلان مرهم إنوتيول Inotyol / إعلان ملح أندروز الكبدي / إعلان فيلم البورسعيدي - سراج منير، فاتن حمامة
translation: "Bayt Min Al-Jou'a!" (A House of Hunger!) — dramatic short story column; Inotyol topical antiseptic ointment ad — "heals wounds, softens skin, cures itching, dermatitis, eczema"; Andrews Liver Salt ad — "Yes! You Feel Bright After Bathing — But True Inner Cleanliness Requires…"; and film ad for "Al-Boursaidi" starring Serag Munir, Faten Hamama, Abdulaziz Mahmoud and Zaki Rostom, with headshots of the leading cast

arabic_text: شروق القمر - قصة سينمائية / صورة نبيل راسل - وستدرج الحب على قصة الحياة
translation: "Shurooq Al-Qamar" (Rising of the Moon) — double-page cinematic-story spread: full-face color portrait of the Egyptian starlet in the leading role framed by dark wavy hair against a peach-pink background, alongside four black-and-white film-stills of the male lead "Nabil Ryzel" in various romantic and dramatic scenes

arabic_text: شوقشه الحب - قصة قصيرة - بقلم إبراهيم عبد القادر المازني وزينب عبد الحميد المحامية - يجب أن تقبله / يجب أن ترفضه
translation: "Shawqashah Al-Hobb!" (Love Confuses Her!) — full-page dual-column short-story feature: parallel narratives by Ibrahim Abdul-Qader Al-Mazny ("He Must Accept Her") and lawyer-writer Zainab Abdel-Hameed Al-Muhamiya ("She Must Refuse Him") arguing opposite views on a love dilemma; illustrated with a striking pen-and-ink drawing of a dreamy dark-eyed woman with cascading hair and a fedora-clad shadow suitor behind her

arabic_text: لحظة جنون! - قصة تاريخية من عام 1875 - رجل غنى فقد كل شيء بسبب قطار / إعلان أجهزة راديو / إعلان بيرة ستيلا
translation: "Lahza Junoon!" (A Moment of Madness!) — historical anecdote from 1875 about a wealthy man who lost 40,000 roubles at a train station; illustrated with a mustachioed man's silhouette portrait. Alongside Muhammad Ali Hijazi ad for radio-appliances by installment ("pay in installments") and Stella beer ad "Ask for Stella beer!"

arabic_text: كواكب فبراير ونجواهن… في مرآة من زجاج أبيض - نور الهدى، سراج منير، مديحة يسرى، ريتا بروديت، أيدة شريف، بهيجة حافظ
translation: "February's Stars and Their Voices… in a Mirror of White Glass!" — full-page tinted-red photo montage of Egyptian actresses and singers: large central portrait of Nour El-Hoda smiling; large portrait of Rita Barvot; inset headshots of Serag Munir(?), Naima Wasfi, Aida Chreef, Bahiga Hafez, Faten Hamama and Nadia Fahmy — each with a caption profiling her recent hit or upcoming film

arabic_text: 7142 قارئاً يشتركون في مسابقة إعلانات الاثنين - قائمة الفائزين بالمسابقة الإعلانية
translation: "7,142 Readers Compete in the Al-Itnayn Advertisement Contest!" — official announcement page listing the winners of the 26 April 1948 advertising-recognition contest (organized with 3,232 correct entries), with prize-tiers: 1st prize 10 pounds to Sirry Abdul-Ghani (Sudan-Khartoum), 2nd prize (5 pounds) to Jouharachi Khalil (Cairo), 3rd prize (3 pounds) to Abdul-Hamid Alsalman (Aleppo) and 12 winners of 5 pounds each — plus full list of subscriber-winners across Egypt, Syria, Sudan and Palestine and a solution-key of the contest advertisements (Coca-Cola, Kolynos, Silknatex, Aspro, Camel Brand, etc.)

arabic_text: "الإخوان" في عشرين عاماً - تاريخ جماعة الإخوان المسلمين - مع صورة المرشد العام حسن البنا وأسرته
translation: "'The Ikhwan' In Twenty Years!" — full-page feature on the history of the Muslim Brotherhood (Al-Ikhwan Al-Muslimeen) since its founding in Ismailia in 1928 by Hasan Al-Banna, expansion under Ismailia branches, Cairo headquarters in 1932, and estimated 2 million members by 1948; illustrated with a candid photo of the General Guide Hasan Al-Banna with his wife and daughter at home in a Cairo living-room

arabic_text: تأكل ثم تنبذ ورقة بالية! - قصة قصيرة - مع رسم ملون لفتاة تلعب مع كلب في الحقول وشاب فقير يراقبها
translation: "She Eats Then Discards a Worn-Out Paper!" — poignant short story about class contrast between a country lad and a rich city-girl; illustrated with a striking full-page red-and-brown color painting of a young lady in a fashionable coat playfully petting a large dog in a country field while a peasant boy watches from a distance

arabic_text: كل شيء - أخبار العالم - مع كاريكاتير العم سام يستحم شيانج كاي شيك في الحوض
translation: "Kul Shay!" (Everything!) — miscellaneous world-news roundup: items on China (US aid to Chiang Kai-shek), the Syrian-Iraqi Arab-League preparations, the failed UN Palestine mediator's mission, drought in Damietta, and the situation in Damascus; illustrated with a fine political cartoon of Uncle Sam nervously trying to soap a squirming baby-Chiang Kai-shek in a bathtub, with an angry Mao-figure looming from the smoke behind them

arabic_text: لكل وقت تسريحة! - نصائح جمال للسيدات - أربع تسريحات للأوقات المختلفة
translation: "Likul Waqt Tasreeha!" (For Every Occasion a Hairstyle!) — full-page beauty photo-essay: four side-by-side model photographs illustrating four appropriate coiffures — a morning hairstyle with hair pulled back into an elaborate up-do, an afternoon style with a fresh-flower ornament, an evening-ball style with braided and jewelled bun, and a formal off-neck style

arabic_text: غلاف العدد 719 - 22 مارس 1948 - صورة كبيرة ملونة لشقراء ذات شعر مموج
translation: Front cover of issue no. 719 (22 March 1948): full-page color close-up portrait of a Hollywood-style blonde with a high-swept auburn front-curl and glossy red lipstick, smiling into the camera against a bold vertical-striped red background

arabic_text: عريس أفندي… تاجر أخبار! - قصة ساخرة عن عريس يبيع الأخبار / إعلان صنعات الجمل السمن الهولندي / إعلان ملح أندروز الكبدى
translation: "Aris Effendi… Tajir Akhbar!" (Groom Effendi… News-Merchant!) — full-page satirical short-story about a new bridegroom who barters gossip-tidbits about his own household with in-laws and neighbors; alongside "Sana'aat Al-Jamal" (Camel Brand Syrian butter substitute — Made in Holland) full-page ad and an Andrews Liver Salt "Morning Drink" advertisement

arabic_text: تصفية "الاثنين" - مسابقة القراء / محلات أحمد على - قائمة أسعار الشعير / إعلان أعز الذكرين ورنيش World Body Polish
translation: "Tasfiya Al-Itnayn" (Al-Itnayn Elimination-Quiz!) — reader crossword-style ad-matching puzzle; alongside Ahmed Ali stores' current-price list of hair-and-body items (14 hair-and-body items with prices in millimes), "World Body Polish" body-polish ad (glamorous blonde headshot), and "Al-Sitna Nudra…" (Sunday Freshness) ad with two women peering into a mirror

arabic_text: بطل فلسطين الأول… حياة صلاح الدين من أقواله - مقال تاريخي مع رسم صلاح الدين الأيوبي بسيفه ودرعه
translation: "Batal Falastin Al-Awal… Hayat Salah Al-Din Min Aqwalih!" (The First Hero of Palestine… The Life of Salah Al-Din from His Own Sayings!) — full-page historical/patriotic essay evoking Saladin as inspiration for the Palestine cause of 1948, quoting his memoirs and battle counsel; illustrated with a magnificent painting of Saladin in full silver chainmail and blue turban with sword and red-shield, and a smaller inset of a horseback battle scene

arabic_text: من القصص الأمريكي - هكذا كانت أمي! - قصة مترجمة - مع رسم لسيدة تودع ابنها في المحطة
translation: "Hakadha Kaanat Ummi!" (This Is How My Mother Was!) — American short-story translation about a mother's stoic farewell to her son leaving home; illustrated with a full-color tinted drawing of a well-dressed matron waving from the train platform as her handsome dandified son boards, framed by the ornate arches of a small-town railway station

arabic_text: 3 روميو… وجولييت واحدة! - قصة قصيرة - مع رسم فتاة بفستان منقط تعانق كلباً
translation: "3 Romeo… Wa Juliet Wahida!" (Three Romeos and One Juliet!) — humorous short story about three rival suitors and one lady, continuation from a previous issue; illustrated with a cheeky cartoon of a wide-eyed lady in a polka-dot dress hugging her Alsatian dog protectively

arabic_text: تكملة قصة قروية - مع رسم ملون لفتاة قروية وشاب يرعيان أغناماً تحت شجرة
translation: Continuation of a village-love short story — with a striking full-color panel of a country peasant boy in dark abaya and his headscarved bride embracing beneath a tree, a flock of sheep and lambs milling about the meadow at their feet under an orange-tinted sky

arabic_text: العروبة في مفترق الطرق! - مقال سياسي عن الجامعة العربية - مع صورة الأمير سعود مع أمير مصري
translation: "Al-Uruba Fi Mufaraq Al-Turuq!" (Pan-Arabism at the Crossroads!) — political essay on the Arab League's failures over the Palestine question and Yemen crisis, urging the necessity for real Arab political-economic unity; illustrated with a photo of Prince Faisal ibn Saud (later King Faisal) seated in an ornate chair beside a young Egyptian prince at a hospitality reception, with a low table between them

arabic_text: عصا سحرية… تكشف عن جريمة! - قصة بوليسية / إعلان كنالاثنين البيبى - سيروب نبيذ صحى
translation: "'Asa Sahriya… Takshaf 'An Jareema!" (A Magic Wand… Reveals a Crime!) — full-page detective/true-crime story about a bygone Egyptian murder mystery cracked by a witness's dowsing-rod; alongside a Kinal-Itnayn wine-syrup health-tonic advertisement with a red-cross-nurse figure holding the bottle and a captioned label

arabic_text: هاجر حمدي تحب؟! - حوار مع الممثلة / تجنب النساء - نصيحة الحكيم بتاح حتب منذ 4500 سنة - مع صورة عباس كامل
translation: "Hajir Hamdi Tuhib?!" (Does Hajir Hamdi Love?!) — Egyptian-actress interview with photograph of the star, alongside a philosophical essay on the 4500-year-old wisdom of the Egyptian sage Ptahhotep — "Avoid Women!" — with a fine drawing of a Pharaonic scribe writing at a papyrus scroll and a headshot of Egyptian actor Abbas Kamel

arabic_text: الجنود النقاهرون في ضيافة الفاروق - صورة كبيرة لعائدين من فلسطين مع شيوخ / مسألة كرامة!
translation: "The Convalescent Soldiers Enjoying King Farouk's Hospitality!" — striking large photograph of rows of turbaned and tarboush-wearing wounded veterans and religious sheikhs seated at a royal reception drinking from cups, holding cigars; accompanying article "Mas'ala Karama!" (A Matter of Honor!) on the moral duty of Egypt to press on with the Palestine campaign despite UN pressure

arabic_text: لكل حكيمة ذكرى! - مذكرات طبيب / إعلان معجون كولينوس / إعلان أعلام القصة الذهنية - اعتراف الأجراس
translation: "Likul Hakima Zikra!" (For Every Doctor a Memory!) — column of first-person anecdotes from Egyptian physicians about strange cases (a woman's peculiar phobia, a runaway fiancée, an incident with cocaine-inhaling patient), illustrated with small cartoons; alongside a Kolynos Dental Cream ad (smiling gentleman "has generous foam") and an ad for the detective-story book "E'tiraf Al-Ajras" (Confessions of the Bells) by Adel Fouad Rouyan

arabic_text: الحكم… - بقلم الأستاذ عبد الحميد فهمي بك / إعلان فندق الشتراويش / إعلان فيلم بنات الريف - يوسف وهبي
translation: "Al-Hukm…" (The Rule…) — political essay by Prof. Abdul-Hameed Fahmi Bey ("The Sadd Pier of Egypt's National Rule") on constitutional-monarchy governance; alongside "Fondouk Al-Shatrawishi" luxury Alexandria beach-hotel opening ad and a poster for the film "Banat Al-Reef" (The Village Girls) starring Yousef Wahby, Ferrat Sindy and a cast headshot ensemble

arabic_text: فيم ينظف بسرعة وأمان - إعلان مسحوق فيم / وزارة الصحة العمومية - المرافق العامة - إعلان مناقصة قروية
translation: "Vim Yanzif Bi-Sur'a Wa Aman!" (Vim Cleans Fast and Safely!) — full-page Vim scouring-powder ad showing a housekeeper triumphantly holding up a gleaming table beside kitchen and bath fixtures Vim has cleaned; alongside an official Ministry of Public Health notice — Rural Sanitation Department — announcing tenders for supply of 400 iron pumps and Ministry paper-lot number 268

arabic_text: لقاح الهيط خلال موسم الحج ولكن اسبرو - إعلان أسبرو / نتيجة مسابقة أجمل صورة لطفل
translation: "Combat the Heat During the Hajj Season — But Take Aspro!" — full-page Aspro tablets advertisement targeting pilgrimage-going Egyptians with heat-fatigue relief; alongside contest results "Ajmal Sourat Tefl" (Prettiest Baby Photo) awarding 46 prizes with the winners' names and towns listed

arabic_text: إعلان صابون روضة كامل الصفحة - مصنوع من زيت الزيتون النقي - 8 مليم للقطعة / تكملة قصة / إعلان الهلال - عدد خاص
translation: Full-page Rawda Soap advertisement — "Manufactured from pure olive-oil, 8 milliem per bar" — showing a bath-tub scene with the same bare-shouldered lady reaching for the soap-cube; alongside a short-story continuation and a promo footer for Al-Hilal magazine's next special issue on 1 October

arabic_text: عفريت البئر - قصة غامضة - مع رسم ملون لعفريت أحمر يخرج من الدخان أمام رجل مسن
translation: "Afreet Al-Bareed!" (Ghost of the Well!) — mystery story by a former court-consultant about a djinn haunting a well in an Egyptian village; illustrated with a spectacular full-color painting: a red-flame-turbaned skeletal-devil genie rising from swirling smoke above a kneeling elderly Bedouin man in a keffiyeh who tends a small fire, while ghostly-white maidens loom in the smoke behind

arabic_text: في المريخ - تكملة قصة / ليلة من ليالي الربيع - بقلم الأستاذ محمد الناشي / إعلان لمبات فيليبس / إعلان شراب بلومكس ضد السعال
translation: "Fi Al-Mareekh" (On Mars!) — continuation of a serialized science-fantasy story from a previous issue; below, a nostalgic short-story "Layla Min Layali Al-Rabee'" (A Night of Spring Nights) by Muhammad Al-Nashai; alongside a Philips light-bulbs full-page ad ("Are you satisfied with the light you have?") and a Bloomex cough-syrup children's ad

arabic_text: خل وزيت - ثلاثة مقالات فلسفية - شراب بقلم الدكتور طه حسين، الخل وحرية الأذهان بقلم إبراهيم عبد القادر المازني، الخل والزيت بقلم الأستاذ أحمد زكي
translation: "Vinegar and Oil" — full-page triangular philosophical essay-collection: (right) "Sharab… bi Qalam Al-Doctor Taha Hussein Bey" (Drink… by Dr Taha Hussein) — a wry piece on wine and Islamic prohibition; (left) "Al-Khall wa Hurriyat Al-Adhhan" (Vinegar and Freedom of Minds) by Ibrahim Abdul-Qader Al-Mazny — vinegar as symbol of intellectual liberation; (bottom) "Al-Khall wa Al-Zayt" (Vinegar and Oil) by Prof. Ahmad Zaki — illustrated with a still-life of two decanters on an ornate scale beam

arabic_text: عروس البحر - تكملة قصة / إعلان محلات النطاطيري لملابس عيد الأضحى / إعلان كولونيا سورين / إعلان بيرة ستيلا
translation: "'Aroos Al-Bahr!" (Bride of the Sea!) — continuation from previous page of a short story about a naive village girl; alongside an ad for Al-Nataari Cairo store's Eid Al-Adha shirt-and-pajama-and-textile promotion, Cologne "Surien" ad with an elegant blonde head-portrait, and a Stella beer "'Alama Al-Damaan" (Guarantee-Star) advertisement

arabic_text: أنت وفتى أحلامك! - في الصيف موسم الإجازات وفصل الفراغ والحب - يستقبل قلب الفتاة
translation: "You and the Youth of Your Dreams!" — full-page pink-red romantic feature: a large heart-cutout portrait of a chestnut-haired beauty in pearls in three-quarter profile, framed against orange-pink starburst rays; a Cupid-figure aims his arrow from the left corner; caption launches a series of five character-analyses of young men "in the summer of vacations, of leisure, and of love… to predict your dream fellow's true nature"

arabic_text: هؤلاء أضاءوا زمانهم قبل أن أشنه! - سيرة الشيخ إبراهيم المنصف - بقلم عبد الله رمضان / إعلان فنانة مصر ملك / إعلان ورنيش الكرة World Body Polish
translation: "These Lit Up Their Age Before They Faded!" — biographical essay by Abdullah Ramzan on Sheikh Ibrahim Al-Munsef, a beloved but now-forgotten mid-century Egyptian personality; sidebar: photo of "Fanana Misr Malak" (Star of Egypt Malak) promoting her 15th film "Ta'nissah 'Umr" (My Life's Punishment) at Studio Misr October 1949; and a "World Body Polish" varnish body-lotion ad

arabic_text: أنا مظلم! - للأستاذ سراج منير - صورة كاملة الصفحة / إعلان أقراص أسبرو - لا تتصدى للحر / إعلان القصص - عدد خاص من الهلال
translation: "Ana Muzlim!" (I Am Gloomy!) — full-page satirical caricature-portrait feature: a striking silhouette-drawing of the actor Serag Munir in a black opera-cape frowning against a vast dark blob-shape; below the drawing, an autobiographical humor-piece in his voice; alongside a full-page Aspro tablets ad — "Do Not Confront the Heat by Yourself — Aspro is Your Protection!" — and a promo for Al-Hilal magazine's special short-story issue "Al-Qissas"

arabic_text: عندما غارت البوليس النسائي! - قصة قصيرة / إعلان فيلم صاغ مصري - ليلى مراد، يحيى شاهين، عماد حمدي
translation: "Indama Gharat Al-Boules Al-Nisa'i!" (When the Women's Police Raided!) — Egyptian short-story about a policewoman's dramatic raid on an underground gambling den; alongside a film-poster ad for "Sagh Misry" (An Egyptian Gold Bar) with headshots of Layla Murad, Yehia Chahine and Emad Hamdi

arabic_text: نجوم هوليوود في الامتحان - واندا هندريكس - صورة كبيرة ملونة للنجمة
translation: "Hollywood Stars in the Test!" — full-page glamour portrait of Hollywood ingénue Wanda Hendrix in soft-focus color with red lipstick and downcast eyes, in a cream trench-collar blouse; feature-caption profiles her breakthrough films

arabic_text: غلاف العدد 636 - 19 أغسطس 1946 - انتظار الغروب - صورة ممثلة بفستان أحمر منقط تحمل ماسورة كأنها ساحرة
translation: Front cover of issue no. 636 (19 August 1946) — "Intizar Al-Ghuroub" (Awaiting Sunset): full-page color portrait of an Egyptian actress in a shimmering long red polka-dot lace-detail gown, holding a long cigarette-holder like a wand while backlit against her own shadow on a wall

arabic_text: أيها الفقير؟! - مقال / إعلان ملح أندروز الكبدي / إعلان أقراص بلومكس / إعلان مدرسة بينيت البريطانية بالمراسلة
translation: "Ayoha Al-Faqir?!" (Oh Poor Man?!) — reflective essay on the plight of Egypt's poor and gap between rich and poor in wartime; alongside Andrews Liver Salt "Morning Drink Andrews" ad, Bloomex tablets ad, and a Bennett Institute of Commerce and Accountancy correspondence-course advertisement

arabic_text: لو مات النفاق…! - بقلم الأستاذ توفيق دياب بك - مقال ساخر مع كاريكاتير زوجين على البلاج
translation: "Law Maat Al-Nifaaq!" (If Hypocrisy Died!) — full-page political-satire essay by Prof. Tawfiq Diab Bey imagining a world without political hypocrisy; illustrated with a cartoon of a bored couple sunbathing under a beach umbrella

arabic_text: تكملة قصة درامية - رسم ملون لرجل بكوفية وامرأة بشال أحمر - وجوه حزينة
translation: Continuation of a dramatic short story — with a striking full-color painting: a keffiyeh-wearing dark-eyed man beside a red-shawled young village woman with a wrenching, tearful expression, framed against a village-lane background at dusk

arabic_text: إعلان فيلم عواصف - فاطمة رشدي، زكي رستم، عباس فارس / العلم على القلعة! - مقال / رسم برج القلعة والعلم
translation: Full-page ad for the new Egyptian film "Awasef" (Storms) starring Fatma Rushdi with a dozen supporting-cast headshots including Zaki Rustom, Abbas Fares and Muhammad Al-Nabih; poster shows Rushdi in a peasant embroidered dress raising her hand in defiance; alongside a full-color drawing of the Citadel of Cairo flag-tower with Egyptian flag flying, headlining a patriotic essay "Al-'Alam 'Ala Al-Qal'a!" (The Flag on the Citadel!)

arabic_text: جديد جديد جديد! - أحمر شفاه، أحمر خدود - إنتاج هوليوود الرائع الحديث - ماكس فاكتور بان كيك / الميكروفون الضاحك
translation: "New! New! New! Red Lips, Red Cheeks — Hollywood's Latest Marvel Production!" — full-page Max Factor Hollywood advertisement launching three sparkling new complementary shade-kits (Clear Red / Blue-Red / Rose Red) with a smiling actress-endorser Beji Hafez; alongside "Al-Microphone Al-Dahek" (The Laughing Microphone) — comic radio-humor column, and a footer promo for Al-Hilal's special short-story issue "Al-Qissas"

arabic_text: مفاجأة في ساحة العدالة! - قصة محكمة مصرية / إعلان معجون كولينوس / إعلان بودرة كتنوز
translation: "Mufaja'a Fi Sahat Al-'Adala!" (Surprise in the Court of Justice!) — full-page Egyptian courtroom-drama short-story of an unexpected witness that turned a murder trial upside-down; alongside a Kolynos Dental Cream ad with cartoon of a laughing boy and "Kutnow's Powder" digestive antacid ad with jar-and-spoon graphic

arabic_text: غلاف خلفي فارغ - كرتون بني بدون طباعة
translation: Blank back cover / cardboard endpaper — no printed content; buff-brown board with folded corner and a stray Arabic pencil-scribble in the corner

arabic_text: 6 قصص غرام - قصة عن عرسان في نيويورك / إعلان صابون ورد النيل / إعلان شركة عرابى للفوريخ - أسعار الصوف
translation: "6 Qisas Gharam!" (6 Love Stories!) — final-part romance-anthology feature about American newlyweds in New York; alongside a Ward Al-Nil (Rose of the Nile) perfumed soap ad and a full-page ad from Sharikat 'Arabi Trading Co. listing 60 wool-and-textile bargains for the 1948 Eid al-Ghadeer holiday

arabic_text: اضحك مع الحلاقين! - كاريكاتير كامل الصفحة عن أهوال محلات الحلاقة
translation: "Idhak Ma'a Al-Halaqiin!" (Laugh with the Barbers!) — full-page comic-strip feature: (top) manic barber cutting a lady's hair with a giant machete; (middle) an angry mob of clients dragging a runaway barber through the street; (bottom-left) a barber applying lipstick to a bearded gentleman's face; (bottom-right) a barber shaving a customer with a huge razor as blood squirts

arabic_text: إعلان بريلكريم Brylcreem - أحسن علاج للشعر / إعلان سلاار Salaar
translation: Full-page advertising: Brylcreem hair cream — "The Best Treatment for Hair" — with the classic profile of a well-groomed British-style gentleman applying pomade; alongside a "Salaar" (a sparkling drink or product) advertisement with a cheerful cartoon face; and a memoir-continuation column about military anecdotes from the trenches of the previous war

arabic_text: تحية نازدون أمام العميسام! - رسالة مهاجرة للاثنين بقلم فهمي جرجس - عرس مصرية بأمريكا / كاريكاتير هندي عن الزواج
translation: "A Salute Before the Uniform!" — special-correspondent letter to Al-Itnayn from Fahmy Girges about the Egyptian-American church wedding of Ms. Nadouny — an Egyptian émigré in Wisconsin — to an American army lieutenant; illustrated with a photograph of the smiling bride and her groom signing the marriage register beside the priest, and a smaller Indian-couple cartoon on lovers-quarrel

arabic_text: غلاف - صورة كبيرة ملونة لشقراء بفستان ذهبي حريري مربوط بحبل
translation: Front cover: full-page color portrait of a smiling blonde bombshell in an amber-golden silk short-sleeved dress with corset lacing, hair pinned up in careful curls, seated on a fan-pleated skirt against a dark bronze background

arabic_text: طريق الكباش… بقلم الدكتور حسين مؤنس - مقال - مع صورة كبيرة لسيارات مصطفة على الطريق
translation: "Tareeq Al-Kibash…" (The Path of Rams…) — full-page reflective essay by Dr. Hussein Mu'nis using the road-side line of parked/queued Egyptian-farmer cars as a metaphor for a nation being sheep-led; illustrated with a striking large photo of a long row of at least a dozen cars parked in single file on a country track waiting to enter a market

arabic_text: صورة امرأة - قصة مصرية بقلم الأستاذ إبراهيم الوردانى - قصة في قسمين
translation: "Sourat Imra'a" (Portrait of a Woman) — Egyptian short story by Ibrahim Al-Wardany in two vignettes (Part 1 and Part 2) about a soldier who becomes obsessed with the photograph of an unknown woman he found in a Palestine trench, then discovers the truth of who she is

arabic_text: مصر تضحك على محتليها! - نكات صحفية عن الاحتلال البريطاني / إعلان ولاعات رونسون Ronson / إعلان زيت الأنانول للشعر / إعلان شفرات جيليت
translation: "Misr Tudhak 'Ala Muhtaliyha!" (Egypt Laughs at Its Occupiers!) — a journalism-humor column collecting the best Cairene wisecracks about the British occupation; alongside a full-page Ronson lighter ad ("100% Efficiency") — hand holding an elegant Ronson lighter — and "Sadiq Al-Sittayat" (Ladies' Friend) Enanol hair-oil ad and Gillette blades ad

arabic_text: إعلان فيلم زهرة العلا - كامل ومحمود ودائرة الفنانة كيتي ووليم ديفيس - حضرة المحترم / قصة عن الفردوس المفقود
translation: Advertising page: full-page poster for the film "Zahret Al-'Ula" — "Hadrat Al-Muhtaram" (The Notable Gentleman) — a Cambridge-cinema production starring Kamel El-Meligui and Mahmoud Al-Meligui and dancer Kitti, William Davis and Suad Makawi, with William Davis's headshot in inset; alongside a short-story continuation "Fi Al-Firdaws Al-Mafqoud!" (In the Lost Paradise!) illustrated with pen-drawing of a girl by a ladder

arabic_text: نزهة إسماعيل - مقال تاريخي عن الخديوي إسماعيل في باريس / إعلان جرارات ريكس بلاو-نوكس / إعلان بودرة توكالون / إعلان أوتار
translation: "Nazhat Isma'il" (Isma'il's Excursion) — historical anecdote/essay about Khedive Ismail's fabulous Paris excursion and lavish spending patterns; alongside a REX Blaw-Knox Ltd (London) full-page road-paver ad with black-and-white illustration of the machine at work, Toucalon face-powder ad with two lady-portraits, and Autard fizzy drink ad

arabic_text: قصة عن الكاتب الذكي - الدكتور محبوب ثابت / إعلان صابون الأهرام - أفضل صابون للغسيل / إعلان كواكب السينما - يعرض الإمبريال مصرغان الجميل
translation: Article/memoir about the sharp-witted writer Dr Mahboub Thabet Basha (with his portrait sketch), on Egypt's neediest at times of drought; alongside a full-page ad for "Sabun Al-Ahram" (Pyramids Soap) — "Best Cleansing Soap Made from Purest Materials — 400 grammes for 35 milliem"; and "Kawakib Al-Sinema" (Stars of the Cinema) column with photo of a smiling actress in a striped dress

arabic_text: كيف تحسن ذاكرتك؟ - مقال / إعلان الجمعية التعاونية للبترول - سياراتكم / إعلان قطرة برونتكسنن / إعلان أسبيرول
translation: "How to Improve Your Memory?" — health-column essay outlining tips for treating forgetfulness and mental fatigue; alongside a full-page ad for the Egyptian Petroleum Cooperative Society showing gas-pump-and-car graphic; a Bronticinos eye-drops ad; and an Aspirol tablets ad with capsule-in-jar graphic

arabic_text: أنت ليلة النوم العميق تحدث تغييراً واسع المدى! - إعلان أسبرو / المرهقون عن الناس كيف يريحون عن أنفسهم - إسماعيل يس
translation: "You — a Night of Deep Sleep Brings Wide-Ranging Change!" — Aspro tablets full-page ad promoting Aspro for restful sleep, with sketch-caricature portrait; alongside a memoir column on how Egypt's overburdened people find escape, illustrated with three photos of comedian Ismail Yasin — smiling with his son and joking with fellow comedians backstage

arabic_text: في الحال! بان كيك يجعلك تبدين أكثر جمالاً! - ماكياج ماكس فاكتور بان كيك / مسابقة حروف للاعتبار
translation: "In Just 50 Seconds — Pan-Cake Makes You Look More Beautiful!" — full-page Max Factor Pan-Cake makeup advertisement featuring a glamorous cream-shouldered dark-haired actress in a black gown with an inset compact-package graphic; alongside a "Letters-Rearrangement Contest" (Huroof Lil-I'ibar) reader-puzzle with cash prizes

arabic_text: جمالي ضايقنى! - بقلم النجمة ليلى فوزي - صورة كبيرة ملونة للفنانة
translation: "Jamaali Dhayaqni!" (My Beauty Bothers Me!) — full-page confessional-essay by Egyptian starlet Leila Fawzi complaining that her attractiveness has become a burden of stalkers, hangers-on and social-climber offers; illustrated with a large ochre-tinted color portrait of the starlet in a low-cut lace-dress and pearl-choker against dark maroon curtains

arabic_text: إحراج! - عمود ساخر عن الحياة اليومية / إعلان صابون نابلسي فاروق - مصنوع من زيت الزيتون النقي 100%
translation: "Ihraaj!" (Embarrassment!) — comedy column of daily-life embarrassing anecdotes and awkward-moment vignettes; alongside a full-page ad for "Nabulsi Farouk" olive-oil soap featuring a large caricature drawing of a bespectacled tarbouche-wearing merchant with cheerful children in the background and a soap-cube inset — "Price per bar 8 piastres — made of 100% pure olive-oil"

arabic_text: جرست الأمة "عسكرة وحرامية"! - بقلم الأستاذ محمد أمين عبده - مقال سياسي عن ذكرى وفاة روزفلت / إعلان مدرسة بينيت البريطانية / إعلان قطرة برونتكسنن
translation: "Jarast Al-Umma… 'Askariya Wa Haraamiya!" (Egypt's Distress Bell — Militarism and Crime!) — full-page political-analysis essay by Muhammad Amin Abdo commemorating the death of President Roosevelt and lamenting Egypt's post-war descent into military dictatorship and organized crime; alongside a Bennett College Sheffield correspondence-courses ad and Bronticinos eye-drops "Precious Jewels" ad

arabic_text: إعلان فيلم ريفولى - مسألة حياة أو موت / إعلان بردويت ضد العث / مجلس مديرية البحيرة - إعلانات مناقصات
translation: Advertising page: film ad for "Rivoli" cinema's new showing "Mas'alat Hayat Aw Mawt!" (A Question of Life or Death!) — with an inset dramatic photo of the film's leading man; alongside a Bordwin "Moth Rings" moth-repellent tin ad, and a Beheira Governorate notice on new municipal-supply tenders

arabic_text: رقصة العذارى - رقصة هندية دينية - اثنتا عشرة صورة لكيكي الراقصة
translation: "Raqsat Al-'Adhara" (The Virgins' Dance) — full-page photo-essay demonstrating an Indian ritual dance performed to Bharatanatyam-style poses: twelve numbered pose-shots of dancer "Kiki" in a white blouse and long-slim black skirt executing the twelve arm-and-hand gestures of the classical dance — with commentary describing the dance's origins as a temple offering

arabic_text: إعلان مستحضرات فرجينيا للتجميل / بشرى للتجار / إعلان ماء كولونيا تمارا / تحقيق مصور عن نساء - يجوز عشرة آلاف جنيه!
translation: Advertising page: Ferricinia beauty preparations ad — with lady's portrait in a headscarf; a "Bushra Lil-Tujar!" (Good News for Merchants!) — Peinture Egyptian textile-warehouses supply announcement; a Tamara cologne ad with a lady lounging on a chaise; and a "Yajouz 'Ashar Alaaf Ginayh!" (Ten Thousand Pounds Possible!) satirical drawing of a pack of gossipy ladies around a diva-figure

arabic_text: قلق… يجب الإبطال - مقال سياسي / إعلان مسابقة يانصيب الاثنين - 100 جنيه
translation: "Qalaq… Yajib Al-Ibtal!" (Anxiety… Must Be Undone!) — full-page political-analysis essay on Egypt's post-war economic-and-political disquiet; alongside a bold full-page ad for Al-Itnayn magazine's "Yanaseeb Al-Itnayn" prize-lottery with headline "100 Gunayh Ha'iz Yanaseeb Al-Itnayn — Details and How to Subscribe in Next Issue"

arabic_text: عرفت برنادوت… بقلم عبد الرحمن عزام باشا - مذكرات عن الوسيط الأممي في فلسطين - مع صورة للقاء
translation: "'Araft Bernadotte…" (I Knew Bernadotte…) — memoir-essay by Abdul-Rahman 'Azzam Pasha (Secretary-General of the Arab League) recounting his meetings with UN Palestine mediator Count Folke Bernadotte before his assassination; illustrated with a photograph of 'Azzam Pasha shaking hands with the Count, an aide standing beside them, at an Arab-League Cairo reception

arabic_text: الملك فاروق في حفلة شركة سيارات الطرق الصحراوية - صورة الملك على المائدة الرئيسية / الملك يفتتح سيارة صحراوية جديدة
translation: Full-page photo-feature: (top) large photograph of King Farouk seated at the head of a formal banquet dinner at the Egyptian Sahariya (Desert-Road) Car Company inauguration, flanked by ministers, an ambassador and turbaned princes; (bottom-left) inset photograph of the King at the door of a shiny new Sahariya Company sedan, with a young lady in a white hat and gloves inspecting it beside him — article on Egypt's growing highway-and-motor-industry ambitions

arabic_text: لكل كوكب "ماركة" مسجلة! - كاريكاتير موضة النجمات - رانيا إبراهيم مع مربعات على وجهها
translation: "Every Star Has a Registered Trademark!" — double-page fashion-analysis feature identifying each Egyptian actress's signature look with a fan-shaped array of five headshots on one side (Fatma Rushdi, Aida Chreef, Naima Wasfy and others), and a large full-page color half-face portrait of actress Raqia Ibrahim with a translucent geometrical square overlaid on her eyes and lips highlighting her signature makeup features

arabic_text: عائلات للإيجار! - مقال طريف / إعلان أوفالتين - الحياة مرهقة - المشهية والقوى مفقودة
translation: "'A'ilaat Lil-Ijar!" (Families for Rent!) — humor essay on how post-war Cairo's servant-shortage has spawned agencies renting out entire family-units by the day; alongside a full-page Ovaltine drink advertisement — "Life Is Tiring — Appetite and Strength Are Lost — Ovaltine Hot or Cold Refreshes and Renews Vigor" — with a graphic of a smiling maid holding a tray of Ovaltine

arabic_text: الحطر! - عمود قصص قصيرة / كاريكاتير رجل بطربوش وامرأة على كنبة - عادت ماما ما نصكيت معاناً
translation: "Al-Hattaar!" (Look Out!) — humor short-story column on domestic mishaps and family mix-ups; illustrated with a full-panel comic drawing of a tarbouche-wearing effendi being manhandled onto a couch by a haughty dark-haired lady (his mother-in-law?) — caption reads "Well then! When you have a good teacher of manners… will Mama return to guide us both!"

arabic_text: هوليوود البلد مصر - عمود سينمائي - محمد عبد الوهاب، سمير غانم، زكي رستم / إعلان صابون البلدي / إعلان بيرة كامل الصفحة
translation: "Hollywood El-Balad Misr" (Hollywood in Egypt) — cinema-industry news column with headshot photos of Muhammad Abdulwahab (with tarbouche), Samir Ghanem, Zaki Rustom and a starlet-actress; items on new Egyptian films premiering at Studio Misr; alongside a Baladi household-soap ad and a full-page Ayana Kalrabih beer/drink ad ("first color film in Egypt") and Bata shoes ad

arabic_text: قبل الرحيل إلى ميدان القتال - تحقيق مصور عن جنود مصريين يستعدون لجبهة فلسطين - يتدربون ويصلون ويودعون ممرضة
translation: "Qabl Al-Raheel Ila Maydan Al-Qital!" (Before Departure to the Battlefield!) — patriotic photo-essay on Egyptian troops preparing for the Palestine front: (right, top-inset) portrait of a stern helmeted Egyptian soldier; (center) a group of soldiers standing at attention as a nurse solemnly shakes hands with a helmeted officer beside a jeep and provisions; (bottom) rows of kneeling soldiers performing the Muslim prayer on the sandy training ground before mounting up

arabic_text: الأسبوع الثالث - سينما ريفولى بالقاهرة - فيلم المغامر - بطولة محمود المليجى، ساميه جمال، حسين رضا
translation: Advertising page: full-page ad for the film "Al-Mughamir" (The Adventurer) — third week at Cinema Rivoli Cairo — starring Mahmoud Al-Meligui, Samia Gamal and Hussein Riyad; poster shows lead-couple pair-photo of the black-hatted heroine with the mustachioed leading man; below, story-continuation column about a movie-star's fan-encounter in Alexandria

arabic_text: هدية رائعة لعام 1948 - ساعة جميلة من مجوهرات عكاوى - إعلان كامل الصفحة - بيتي هاتون
translation: "A Magnificent Gift for the Year 1948 — A Beautiful Watch from Akkawi Jewelers!" — full-page full-color advertisement featuring Paramount Pictures blonde starlet Betty Hutton as endorser: her upswept-hair portrait in an elegant gown with pearls, holding up a rectangular gold ladies' wristwatch that fills the bottom-left of the page — Akkawi jewelry at 42 Sulayman Basha Street Cairo

arabic_text: زرعت مثلث الرعب في فلسطين! - رسالة خاصة من الأستاذ سمير سوق عن ثورة فلسطين 1936 - القاوقجى - خريطة نابلس وطولكرم وجنين
translation: "Zar'at Muthallath Al-Ru'b Fi Falastin!" (The Triangle of Terror Sown in Palestine!) — special-correspondent front-line report by Prof. Samir Souq on the 1948 Palestine uprising; illustrated with a highlighted map of the Nablus-Tulkarem-Jenin "Triangle of Terror" and a large photograph of Fawzy Al-Qawuqji seated in tribal robes beside a keffiyeh-wearing sheikh, showing the popular Arab Liberation Army command

arabic_text: الجنازة حارّة! - قصة قصيرة ساخرة / إعلان معجون أسنان جيبس S.R - أسنان قوية ولثة سليمة
translation: "Al-Janaza Harra!" (The Hot Funeral!) — humorous short-story about a burning-hot Egyptian funeral procession; alongside a full-page Gibbs S.R. dental cream ad showing a smiling lady applying paste to her toothbrush — "For Strong Teeth and Healthy Gums" with tube-in-package graphic

arabic_text: مستشفى الريحاني وشارع عبد الوهاب - مقال / صورة ملونة لممثلة شقراء تسند ذقنها على يدها / إعلان ساعات جيني
translation: "Mustashfa Al-Rihany wa Shari' Abdulwahab" (The Al-Rihany Hospital and Abdulwahab Street) — reflective essay/memoir about the intersection of Cairo's leading comedian and its most famous composer; illustrated with a large tinted color portrait of a peroxide-blonde bombshell resting her chin on her jewelled wrist against a deep bottle-green background; alongside a Genie luxury-watches advertisement — "Most Famous and Most Accurate Watches"

arabic_text: فيم ينظف بسرعة وأمان - إعلان مسحوق فيم كامل الصفحة / إعلان بودرة توكالون / مقال عن ألوان الشعر
translation: "Vim Yanzif Bi-Sur'a Wa-Aman!" (Vim Cleans Fast and Safely!) — full-page Vim scouring-powder ad again with maid-holding-mirror graphic; alongside a Toucalon face-powder advertisement with two lady-portrait inset (endorsed by Nour Al-Sha'lan) and a fashion-column essay on the cyclical trends in women's hair-color from blonde to brunette across the decades

arabic_text: أحسن ما في السوق - نابلسي فاروق! - إعلان صابون / سر الفتنة والشباب الناضر! - إعلان بيل بينز BILE BEANS
translation: "Ahsan Ma Fi Al-Souq — Nabulsi Farouk!" (The Best in the Market — Nabulsi Farouk!) — a repeat of the caricatured spectacled-tarbouche merchant Nabulsi Farouk soap ad; alongside a full-page "Sir Al-Fitna wa Al-Shabab Al-Nadher!" (Secret of Fascination and Blooming Youth!) BILE BEANS herbal digestive-tablets advertisement with a slim smiling lady-figure holding her hat; and an "'Arif" advice-column vignette

arabic_text: حواء الخالدة - إعلان مجلة الهلال يونيو - ثلاث أغلفة كتب مع صور فنانات مصر
translation: "Hawaa Al-Khalida" (Eve the Eternal) — full-page ad for Al-Hilal Publishing's book-series "Hilal Yunio" — three overlapping book-jackets displayed diagonally, each with a headshot of a leading Egyptian actress on its cover — releasing the special June 1st issue (200 pages, 6 piastres) covering "Eve the Eternal" — Egyptian women's history

arabic_text: المغني المجهول - فيلم جديد - إعلان مع صور كامل الطاقم - الكحلاوى، ماليا بينا الكرسال / إعلان محلات حسن منصور
translation: Advertising page: full-page poster for the new Egyptian musical film "Al-Mughanni Al-Majhool" (The Unknown Singer) — starring Musa Kahlawi and the diva Halia Bina Al-Kursal, with photos of the ensemble musical cast in evening dress; alongside a Hussein Mansour Cairo drapes-and-fabrics shop Eid-Al-Adha ad and a Fayoum Governorate school-supplies tender notice

arabic_text: الفاروق إلى… القاهرة! - مقال - نقول / إعلان بيلوكسين ضد السعال / إعلان ديتول المطهر / إعلان الغزالة / إعلان أحمد رومان لأدواء الصدر
translation: "Al-Faroub Ila… Al-Qahira!" (The Return to… Cairo!) — political commentary on the resumption of King Farouk's Cairo affairs after summer; alongside a Belloxin cough-tablets ad, Dettol antiseptic ad, an Al-Ghazala leather-goods ad, and an Ahmed Roman chest-medicine ad with drug-and-jar graphics
